title: UK Finance Administrator – Xero Expert (Property Group)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based) 

Employment Type: Full-Time Working Hours: UK-overlap shift (some hours must align with UK business hours — exact schedule discussed at interview) 



About Us

We're a group of UK property companies — asset-owning entities plus a lettings/management company, operating together as one group. We're growing, and we need a dependable finance professional to help keep our books, reconciliations, and day-to-day finance admin running smoothly across multiple companies.



The Role

We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Finance Administrator to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping, invoicing, and finance admin in Xero. You'll work closely with our accountant and directors, keeping our multi-company accounts accurate, our invoices chased, and our reconciliations tight — without needing to be micromanaged.



This is a broad, hands-on role covering three areas:



1. Bookkeeping & Xero Data Entry



Day-to-day bookkeeping and reconciliation across multiple companies

Rent reconciliations and allocations in Xero and our property accounting CRM

Maintaining accurate, up-to-date financial records in line with UK accounting standards



2. Invoicing, AP/AR & Reconciliations



Commercial rent invoicing, reconciliation, and chasing outstanding payments

Accounts payable and accounts receivable

Monitoring expenditure and ensuring all invoices are obtained and correctly linked in Xero

Bank reconciliations

Service charge accounting and invoicing for leaseholders on freehold properties



3. General Admin & Light Finance Support



Preparing monthly management accounts and reports (profit/loss by company)

Supporting profit & loss reports, balance sheets, and cash flow statements

Assisting with year-end accounts preparation, working alongside our external accountant

Monitoring utility and other expenses

General financial admin and record-keeping to keep everything audit-ready



What We're Looking For

3+ years of UK finance/bookkeeping experience — you must have worked for a UK company in a similar role

Strong, hands-on Xero expertise — this is essential, not optional

Confident in Excel

Familiarity with UK company accounts, VAT, and HMRC basics

UK property sector experience is a strong advantage

Excellent written and spoken English

Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable managing your own workload without constant supervision

Able to work hours that overlap with the UK working day



Preferred (not required):



ACCA, ACA, CIMA, AAT, or equivalent qualification

Experience managing multi-company accounts

Experience with UK property or SME businesses



Why Join Us

Long-term, stable full-time role with a growing UK property group

Varied work across multiple companies — never just data entry

Direct exposure to UK property accounting, service charges, and multi-entity finance

Work directly with directors and our external accountant



How to Apply

Please complete our short application form here: 



We review every application.

title: VA | Frontend Manager | Product Listing • Campaign Scheduling • Data Enrty • Creative Person | Dropshipping Ecommerce
description:
We're hiring a Frontend Manager for our dropshipping e-commerce business.



We run a dropshipping business with multiple stores in different countries. We're looking for an experienced, highly analytical Frontend Manager to take ownership of the customer-facing and advertising side of our operations — from product listings and ad creative preparation to campaign scheduling, performance analysis, and competitor research. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who genuinely knows Meta advertising inside out — not just how to launch a campaign, but how to read the numbers behind it and tell us what they mean.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

Please include the word "strawberry" somewhere in your application/introduction message. This confirms you've read the full post. Applications without it will not be considered.



We also actively screen applications for AI-generated responses. If we detect that your reply was written by ChatGPT, Claude, or any other AI tool without being personalized by you, you will be immediately disqualified. We want to hear your own voice and your own experience — write it yourself.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As Frontend Manager, you'll own the full front-of-store and advertising pipeline across our brands:



Product Listing

Preparing and optimizing product listings so they're ready to launch and advertise, maintaining consistent quality across stores.



Ad Copy & Creative Prep

Preparing and staging ad copy and creatives in Canva ahead of launch, making sure everything is aligned with our strategy and ready to go live on schedule.



Campaign Scheduling

Scheduling ads and campaigns across Meta accounts, launching new products and managing day-to-day campaign structure.



Data Analysis & Feedback

Digging into performance data daily, spotting trends and issues, and giving us clear, actionable feedback on what's working and what needs to change.



Competitor Research

Researching dropshipping competitors — their products, creatives, and ad strategy — to keep us ahead of the curve.



METRICS YOU SHOULD KNOW COLD

CPC, CTR, CPM, CPA, ATC, Frequency, Daily ROAS, Scaling Sheets



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Must-have:

- Proven experience as a Media Buyer / Frontend Manager in dropshipping or e-commerce

- Deep, hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and all core ad metrics (CPC, CTR, CPM, CPA, ATC, Frequency, Daily ROAS)

- Experience with scaling sheets and structured campaign decision-making

- Proficiency in Canva for preparing and editing ad creatives

- Strong experience with Shopify and product listing preparation

- Skilled in Google Sheets for data tracking and reporting

- Able to independently analyze data and give clear, useful feedback

- Experience conducting competitor research in dropshipping/e-commerce

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

- Highly organized, able to follow a structured workflow and strategy precisely



Nice-to-have:

- Experience with the
 Ad Library for creative/competitor research

- Experience with product research tools

- Comfortable using ChatGPT and Claude AI as work tools

- Experience with Discord (our main comms channel — not Slack)

- Prior experience scaling multiple stores at once



WORKING CONDITIONS

- Communication happens via Discord — please confirm you're comfortable working in this environment.

- Availability: 4–10 hours/day, flexibility required across the week.

- We start with a trial period before moving to a long-term, full-time arrangement.

- Real growth opportunities for team members who show consistency, ownership, and reliability.



PLEASE ANSWER THE FOLLOWING IN YOUR APPLICATION

1. Do you have experience with Shopify and preparing product listings?

2. How many years of experience do you have running/managing Meta ad campaigns?

3. Do you have experience using Canva to prepare or edit ad creatives?

4. Can you confidently explain CPC, CTR, CPM, CPA, ATC, Frequency, and Daily ROAS in your own words?

5. Have you worked with scaling sheets to decide when to scale or kill a campaign?

6. Do you have experience researching dropshipping competitors and their ad creatives?

7. Are you comfortable analyzing data daily and giving structured feedback?

8. Are you comfortable using Discord as your main communication tool?

9. What is your availability (hours/day, days/week)?



If you don't meet the core requirements, please don't apply — we want to keep this process efficient for both sides.



Reminder: don't forget to include the word "strawberry," and please write your application yourself — no AI-generated replies. We check for this, and it's an instant disqualifier if flagged.



Looking forward to your application.



Best regards,

title: VA | Backend Manager | Supply Chain • Customer Service • Quality Control • Supplier Contact| Dropshipping Ecommerce
description:
We're hiring a Backend Manager for our dropshipping e-commerce business.



We run a dropshipping business with multiple stores in different countries. We're looking for a highly skilled, all-round Backend Manager to take ownership of the daily operations across our stores — from supply chain and order fulfillment to customer service, quality checks, and supplier price negotiation.



This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who can independently manage a structured workflow, think critically, and communicate clearly with our team, our suppliers, and our customers.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

Please include the word "strawberry" somewhere in your application/introduction message. This confirms you've read the full post. Applications without it will not be considered.



We also actively screen applications for AI-generated responses. If we detect that your reply was written by ChatGPT, Claude, or any other AI tool without being personalized by you, you will be immediately disqualified. We want to hear your own voice and your own experience — write it yourself.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As Backend Manager, you'll be the central point of coordination across several operational areas:



Supply Chain & Order Fulfillment

Monitoring order fulfillment from start to finish, ensuring suppliers keep their promised delivery times, coordinating with Parcel Panel, and keeping the process delay-free.



Customer Service Oversight

Handling escalations and disputes (including PayPal/payment disputes), responding to customer
s within our 24-hour ETA, and making sure customers receive timely, accurate, and professional responses.



Quality Control

Checking product listings, supplier quality, and overall process quality across stores.



Price Negotiation

Communicating with suppliers to negotiate better pricing and terms.



Data & Reporting

Accurately logging KPIs and operational data into Google Sheets, reporting on refunds and complaints, and generating regular reports per store.



You'll be given full workflows, SOPs, and video training for every part of the process — but we need someone who can take that structure and run with it independently, without needing to be micromanaged.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Must-have:

- Strong experience with Shopify (eCommerce operations, not just basic use)

- Experience with customer service in an e-commerce/dropshipping context (2+ years preferred)

- Comfortable using ChatGPT and Claude AI as work tools

- Experience with DeepL for translations

- Experience with Google Sheets (structuring data, tracking KPIs, formulas)

- Experience with Gmail for professional
 communication

- Experience handling disputes (PayPal or similar)

- Able to consistently meet a 24-hour response time on customer
s

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

- Highly organized, able to follow detailed SOPs precisely



Nice-to-have:

- Experience with Parcel Panel

- Background in supply chain, logistics, or operations

- Experience with supplier price negotiation

- Experience with Discord (our main comms channel — not Slack)



WORKING CONDITIONS

- Communication happens via Discord — please confirm you're comfortable working in this environment.

- Availability: 4–10 hours/day, flexibility required across the week.

- We start with a trial period before moving to a long-term, full-time arrangement.

- Real growth opportunities for team members who show consistency, ownership, and reliability.



PLEASE ANSWER THE FOLLOWING IN YOUR APPLICATION

1. Do you have experience with Shopify? In what capacity?

2. Do you have experience handling customer service and/or disputes for an e-commerce business?

3. Have you used ChatGPT and/or Claude AI as part of your daily workflow?

4. Do you have experience with DeepL or other translation tools?

5. Are you comfortable working with Google Sheets to track KPIs and structure data?

6. Have you generated refund/complaint reports or weekly store reports before?

7. Do you have any experience negotiating with suppliers?

8. Do you have experience with order fulfillment and supply chain coordination?

9. Are you comfortable using Discord as your main communication tool?

10. Can you commit to responding to customer
s within a 24-hour window?

11. What is your availability (hours/day, days/week)?



If you don't meet the core requirements, please don't apply — we want to keep this process efficient for both sides.



Reminder: don't forget to include the word "strawberry," and please write your application yourself — no AI-generated replies. We check for this, and it's an instant disqualifier if flagged.



Looking forward to your application.



Best regards,

title: Online research
description:
Virtual Assistant — Apartment Search & Calling



I’m looking for a proactive virtual assistant to help me find an apartment in San Jose and keep searching until I sign one.



This is not just a Zillow research task. I need someone who will search every day, call landlords/property managers, follow up on old listings, and find apartments that may not be publicly listed yet.



What I’m looking for:



Entire apartment only



1BR/1BA: under $2,500/month, ideally under $2,200



2BR/2BA: under $3,500/month



Priority area: within 0.7 miles of 3155 Olsen Dr, San Jose, CA 95117



Also interested in Villa Cortina / Santana Row



Quiet location is important



In-unit laundry, A/C, parking, and good natural light are preferred





Your job:



Check Zillow, Apartments.com, HotPads, Trulia, Craigslist,
 Marketplace, property-management sites, and other sources every day



Call landlords and apartment buildings in the target areas



Call recently removed listings and ask whether they actually rented



Ask landlords about upcoming or unlisted vacancies



Follow up with good leads



Keep a simple list of everything you’ve contacted



Message me immediately when you find a very good option





For promising apartments, send me the rent, address, bedrooms/bathrooms, distance from 3155 Olsen Dr, listing/contact information, availability, and any important positives or negatives.



Calling is a major part of the job. You should be comfortable speaking with U.S. landlords and property managers in English.



This will likely be 5–10 hours per week for 1–3 weeks, with some work during California business hours.



Philippines- and India-based applicants are welcome.



When applying, please tell me:



1. Your experience with rental or real-estate research





2. Your experience calling U.S. businesses or landlords





3. Your hourly rate





4. Your availability during California hours





5. How soon you can start







Please start your application with “350 Hanson” so I know you read the full post.

title: Video Editor – YouTube Travel & Nightlife Content
description:
## Video Editor – YouTube Travel & Nightlife Content



I’m looking for a **long-term video editor** to help with YouTube travel, nightlife, interview, and vlog-style content.



### #1 REQUIREMENT — DaVinci Resolve



You **must be highly experienced and fluent in DaVinci Resolve**.



This is non-negotiable.



You should be comfortable working efficiently with:



* Edit Page

* Fairlight

* Color Page

* Fusion when needed

* Adjustment clips

* Keyframes

* Tracking and masking

* Face/object blurring

* Audio cleanup and leveling

* Multicam or multiple-camera footage

* Proxies / optimized media

* Project organization

* Export presets and YouTube delivery



I am **not** looking for someone who primarily edits in Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut, or another editor and is simply willing to learn Resolve.



I need someone who already uses DaVinci Resolve regularly and understands it well enough to work quickly without needing basic instruction.



### What I’m Looking For



The ideal editor understands that good editing is much more than removing dead space.



You should have a strong feel for:



* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Comedy and timing

* Keeping conversations interesting

* Knowing when to cut and when to let a moment breathe

* Music selection and placement

* B-roll

* Subtle zooms and motion

* Tasteful sound effects when appropriate

* Building an entertaining story from unscripted footage



The goal is to make the video entertaining because of the **story, personalities, conversations, pacing, and timing** — not because there is an effect every few seconds.



### Editing Style — Important



I am **not** looking for an editor whose primary experience is:



* Gaming videos or gameplay highlight reels

* Gaming clips or montage-style content

* Hyperactive short-form or TikTok-style editing

* Meme-heavy editing

* Constant animated captions

* Excessive zooms

* Flashy transitions

* Overused sound effects

* Random reaction inserts

* Cheesy effects such as “5 hours later,” meme cutaways, cartoon graphics, or similar gimmicks



Those styles may work well for other channels, but they are not the style I am looking for.



My content is primarily **real-world travel, nightlife, interviews, conversations, and vlog footage**.



I prefer editing that feels:



* Natural

* Clean

* Polished

* Mature

* Cinematic when appropriate

* Entertaining without feeling over-edited



A strong editor for this position should understand that sometimes the best editing decision is **not adding anything at all**.



### Current Channel & Future Content



You can review the current channel here:



**YouTube: No Second Chances**



Please watch several videos before applying so you understand the current pacing, style, personalities, and overall tone.



However, do **not** assume every future project will look exactly like the current channel.



We will also be producing other types of content, including:



* Travel videos

* Destination and location guides

* Interviews

* Lifestyle content

* Documentary-style segments

* Restaurant and activity videos

* Other real-world unscripted content



I am looking for an editor who can adapt to different types of videos while still maintaining strong storytelling and good judgment.



### Typical Content



Most projects involve:



* Travel vlogs

* Nightlife videos

* Street interviews

* Restaurant and location segments

* Conversations with guests

* Unscripted situations

* Longer footage that needs to be shaped into an entertaining story



Footage may come from:



* Mirrorless cameras

* Action cameras

* Phones

* 360 cameras

* Multiple cameras during the same shoot



You should be comfortable sorting through longer recordings and identifying the moments that are actually worth keeping.



### Audio



Audio quality is extremely important.



You should be comfortable using **Fairlight** to:



* Balance dialogue levels

* Reduce background noise when appropriate

* Compress dialogue

* EQ voices

* Control peaks

* Mix background music underneath conversations

* Keep volume consistent throughout the video

* Handle audio from different cameras and microphones



I do not want to constantly repair audio after receiving an edit.



### Color



You should be comfortable doing basic color correction and matching footage between different cameras.



I prefer:



* Natural skin tones

* Realistic colors

* Clean contrast

* Consistent exposure

* A polished but realistic image



I do **not** want:



* Heavy HDR looks

* Oversaturation

* Orange skin

* Extreme sharpening

* Aggressive LUTs

* Artificial-looking color grades



### Internet Connection — Very Important



Because we regularly work with **large amounts of high-resolution video footage**, a fast and reliable internet connection is extremely important.



Your computer hardware is your responsibility. I do not care what system you use as long as you can edit the footage efficiently and deliver reliable results.



Your internet connection must be capable of regularly downloading and uploading very large project files.



**Minimum preferred connection:**



* 100 Mbps download

* 100 Mbps upload

* Stable connection

* No restrictive monthly data cap



Faster is strongly preferred.



Applicants may be asked to provide a recent Speedtest result showing download speed, upload speed, and ping.



### Organization



Projects should have:



* Properly named timelines

* Organized bins

* Clean media organization

* Logical folder structure

* Consistent file naming

* No unnecessary duplicate media

* No missing assets when a project is returned



I want to be able to open your DaVinci Resolve project and immediately understand how it is organized.



### Workload



We will start with approximately **one long-form video per week**.



A typical finished video will usually be around **20–40 minutes long**.



If the working relationship goes well, additional projects and more frequent work may become available.



I would rather start slowly, establish a good workflow, and increase the workload once we know we work well together.



### Compensation



Compensation will generally be **per completed video rather than open-ended hourly billing**.



A normal 20–40 minute long-form video will typically pay approximately:



**$80–150 USD per completed video**



Final pricing depends on:



* Amount of raw footage

* Number of cameras

* Audio complexity

* Required masking or blurring

* Amount of B-roll

* Overall difficulty of the project



More complicated projects can be priced separately.



Before work begins, we will agree on the:



* Scope

* Price

* Expected finished length

* Delivery date



Additional work outside the agreed scope should be discussed before doing it.



### Communication & Reliability



I am looking for someone dependable who:



* Communicates clearly

* Can follow detailed notes

* Takes constructive feedback well

* Learns from revisions

* Does not repeatedly make the same mistakes

* Can gradually become more independent

* Meets agreed deadlines



The goal is not for me to supervise every editing decision.



Over time, I want you to understand the channel well enough that I can send footage and notes and receive a strong first edit.



### Portfolio



When applying, please send examples of your **best long-form work**.



I am especially interested in:



* Travel videos

* Vlogs

* Interviews

* Documentary-style content

* Lifestyle content

* Real-world unscripted footage



Please do **not** send only:



* Gaming montages

* Shorts

* TikTok edits

* Music videos

* Meme compilations

* Special-effects reels



If your portfolio does not demonstrate long-form storytelling and pacing, it will be difficult to evaluate whether you are a good fit.



### Paid Test Edit



Final candidates may be asked to complete a **paid test edit** using the same footage and instructions.



This allows me to compare:



* Storytelling

* Editing decisions

* Pacing

* Audio

* Color

* Organization

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions



If the test goes well, we will begin with approximately one video per week and build from there.



I am looking for quality and good judgment, not simply who can add the most effects.



### Current Channel & Future Content



You can review the current channel here:







Please watch **at least 2–3 recent videos before applying** so you understand the current pacing, style, personalities, and overall tone.



When you apply, please tell me:



* Which video(s) you watched

* One thing you think the current editing does well

* One thing you would improve or approach differently



There is no single “correct” answer. I want to see that you actually watched the content and understand the type of editing we are trying to improve.



However, do **not** assume every future project will look exactly like the current channel.



We will also be producing other types of content, including:



* Travel videos

* Destination and location guides

* Interviews

* Lifestyle content

* Documentary-style segments

* Restaurant and activity videos

* Other real-world unscripted content



I am looking for an editor who can adapt to different types of videos while maintaining strong storytelling, natural pacing, and good judgment.

We are looking for a talented and creative **Mid-Level Editor** to join our team and help bring our visual and digital content to life. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong eye for detail, understands modern content trends, and can confidently work across *photography, videography, social media, marketing, and branded content*.



The ideal candidate is both creative and technically skilled, with the ability to take raw photos, video footage, and creative concepts and turn them into polished, engaging content that represents our brand.

* Photography & Photo Editing *



* Edit and retouch professional photography for digital and print use.

* Perform color correction, exposure adjustments, cropping, masking, and image enhancement.

* Retouch portraits, products, events, lifestyle images, and other visual content.

* Maintain consistency in image quality, color, and overall brand style.

* Organize and manage photo libraries and project files.



* Video Editing & Post-Production *



* Edit short-form and long-form video content for social media, marketing, websites, and other platforms.

* Create engaging Reels, TikToks, YouTube videos, promotional videos, advertisements, and branded content.

* Select and organize footage, create compelling cuts, and maintain strong pacing.

* Add music, sound effects, transitions, graphics, captions, titles, and other visual elements.

* Perform color correction and basic color grading.

* Clean and enhance audio when needed.

* Create promotional graphics, advertisements, campaign assets, thumbnails, and digital marketing materials.

* Work closely with marketing, creative, and leadership teams to execute campaigns and projects.

title: ACCOUNT MANAGER | AMAZON & MARKETPLACE BRANDS (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
XP Strategy manages Amazon advertising and marketplace growth for US brands. Many of our clients are seven and eight figure sellers. We handle PPC, creative, catalog, and marketplace expansion across Amazon, Walmart, and Target. Brands stay with us because we go deeper than most agencies do. We are an Amazon Ads Verified Partner with experience in AMC and DSP, plus additional marketplaces like Walmart and Target+. We are a small, senior, fully distributed team, looking to grow with A-players.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Account Manager, you will own a portfolio of client brands end to end. This is an ownership role, not a coordination role. You won't just send reports, relay client requests to specialists, or wait to be told what the account needs. You look at the account, understand what is actually happening, decide what has to change, and direct the team to make it happen.



Our specialists handle bids, creative, and catalog execution. You decide what they are executing toward. When the account grows, that is because you steered it there. When it drifts, you are the one with a plan before the client asks for one.



The job is as much personality as skill. You manage expectations against what is achievable, share the wins when things go right, and stay composed when a client is frustrated.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years of client-facing experience at an Amazon or ecommerce agency, managing multiple brands at once

- Experience with seven-figure Amazon brands and the expectations that come with them

- Strong command of Amazon PPC: campaign types, ACoS vs. TACoS, match types, ranking. Enough to challenge a specialist's plan and explain the trade-off to a brand owner, even though you are not the one adjusting bids

- Proven track record of growing accounts, not just maintaining them

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets. You can build a report, read it, and turn it into a recommendation someone can act on

- Experience directing cross-functional teams without formal authority over them

- Able to navigate a hard conversation professionally: deliver bad news early, hold a realistic line, stay steady under pressure

- Excellent written and spoken English, and genuinely comfortable leading video calls with US brand owners

- Organized under multi-account pressure, with project management tool experience (ClickUp, Asana, or similar)

- Nice to have: DSP exposure, Helium 10 or Data Dive, quarterly business review experience, Walmart or Target retail media, TikTok knowledge



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Client ownership (primary focus)

- Be the main point of contact for your portfolio. Every request, question, and escalation runs through you

- Set concrete targets with each client (ACoS, TACoS, revenue, launch milestones) and revisit them quarterly, monthly for accounts in active launch or peak season

- Own whether those targets get hit. Specialists execute, you steer and course-correct when the numbers drift

- Run onboarding end to end: kickoff call, access collection, expectation setting, and KPI baselines inside the first 30 days



Quality control (the standard we're strictest about)

- Nothing reaches a client until you have checked it against the target it was supposed to move. Not a report, not a strategy doc, not a bulk change

- You are the last line of defense on work that carries our name



Cross-functional direction (without direct reports)

- Drive execution across the PPC, creative, and catalog teams: set priorities and deadlines, give clear feedback, keep everyone aligned on what matters this month

- Be the internal voice of the client. Escalate resourcing conflicts early rather than absorbing them quietly



Communication and retention

- Keep a steady rhythm: weekly written updates, monthly report calls, quarterly business reviews, always framed in business terms like revenue, profitability, and TACoS

- Come to every call with an agenda, insights, and next steps. Flag stockouts, listing issues, and seasonality before the client notices

- Watch for early warning signs (a spend or revenue trend that breaks, two consecutive target misses, a champion leaving, invoices slowing, replies getting shorter) and act within days

- Handle unhappy-client situations directly: acknowledge fast, find the root cause with the team, come back with a specific fix and a date



Growth

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER A YEAR

- Every account has had four real business reviews, not four rescheduled ones

- Your specialists know what matters on each account without asking twice

- Nothing has reached a client that embarrassed us



SCHEDULE

Fully remote. Semi-flexible schedule with substantial overlap required with US Eastern business hours. Client calls happen on their clock.



SALARY

$1,250 to $2,500 per month, depending on experience.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Digital Product Designer
description:
We are looking for a highly detail-oriented designer who can turn concepts, written content, and detailed instructions into polished, visually appealing finished products.



The overall concept, structure, direction, examples, and requirements will be provided. Your role will be to develop the individual pages, create attractive and consistent layouts, and source or generate suitable visual elements.



Strong visual judgment is essential. The products should feel professionally designed, engaging, aesthetically pleasing, and cohesive.



What you’ll be doing



* Designing individual pages based on detailed creative briefs

* Creating attractive, consistent layouts in Canva

* Sourcing or generating illustrations and other visual elements

* Carrying out light research when needed

* Using AI tools for research, content development, visual creation, and improving efficiency

* Adapting the visual style to different target audiences



What we’re looking for



* Strong Canva skills

* An excellent eye for design, layout, and typography

* Strong attention to detail

* Very good written English

* Confidence using AI tools

* Ability to follow detailed instructions accurately

* Ability to make good design decisions independently

* Ability to adapt layouts, typography, illustrations, and overall design direction to different target audiences



Experience creating visually engaging layouts, educational content, games, puzzles, presentations, digital products, or other structured content is a strong advantage.



The use of AI is highly encouraged. We are looking for someone who is comfortable incorporating AI into their workflow.



Workflow:



For each project, you will receive a detailed brief covering the concept, target audience, content direction, examples, and design requirements.



You will work directly in a Canva workspace provided to you and develop the project there. 



The level of creative freedom will vary by project. Some projects will come with very specific direction, while others will leave more room for you to develop the visual approach and contribute your own ideas.



How to apply



Please include:



* A short introduction

* Examples of your strongest design work

* The design and AI tools you currently use, including the specific AI models where relevant

* Your current availability

* Your expected hourly or monthly rate



The role will initially be project-based. If we work well together and the quality of the work is consistently high, the goal is to transition this into a full-time, long-term position.

title: Outbound Cold Caller – B2B (Neutral/American Accent Required)
description:
We're an Australian AI automation agency. You'll be cold calling Australian business owners to book discovery meetings for us. Straight outbound dialling — no inbound, no chat support, no admin.



**READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING**



This role calls Australian business owners who hang up fast. You need to sound neutral or American on the phone. If your accent is noticeably Filipino, please don't apply.  We will reject you and it wastes both our time. Be honest with yourself here.



**What you'll do**

- 100+ outbound dials per day using our dialler 

- Work Manila 7am-3pm (Melbourne 9am-5pm). Non-negotiable, these are the only hours that work.

- Book qualified meetings into our calendar





**What you need**

- 2+ years outbound calling on a US, UK, or Australian account at a real business 

- Outbound sales or appointment setting specifically. nNot inbound customer service

- Wired internet connection (not WiFi) and a proper USB headset

- Backup power/internet arrangement

- You can handle rejection all day without going flat by 11am



**HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or you'll be rejected**



Do not send a CV or a generic intro video. Send a single audio recording, roughly 90 seconds, with these three parts:



1. **(30 sec)** Read this script word for word:

*"Hi, is that [name]? My name's ___, I was just reaching out because we build AI automation systems for Australian businesses to replace admin tasks. Have you looked at anything like that before?"*



2. **(30 sec)** In your own words, unscripted: why would a business owner want to take this call?



3. **(30 sec)** Unscripted: respond to a prospect saying *"I'm not interested, we already have someone doing that."*



Also tell us in your message:

- Which businesses you've worked (company + region)

- Your internet setup (wired or WiFi, speed, backup plan)



Applications without the audio recording will not be read. Applications that only include part 1 will not be read.



**What happens next**

Shortlisted candidates do a live call with us, then a paid trial on real dials before any ongoing arrangement.

### What You’ll Do



* Develop creative concepts and content strategies designed for viral growth

* Provide creative direction to our editing team

* Review edits and give clear, actionable feedback

* Help editors improve hooks, pacing, storytelling, transitions, graphics, music, and overall retention

* Identify trends and find ways to adapt them to our brand

* Develop repeatable content formats and creative frameworks

* Work closely with our team to turn raw footage and ideas into high-performing content

* Continuously test new creative approaches and analyze what is working



### What We’re Looking For



* Proven experience creating or directing **high-performing social content**

* Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram content

* A deep understanding of **viral hooks and audience retention**

* Experience managing or creatively directing video editors

* Excellent communication and ability to give specific, constructive feedback

* Strong creative instincts and a willingness to experiment

* Ability to move quickly and produce a high volume of ideas

* Someone who understands that great editing is about more than making a video look good. It’s about **keeping people watching.**

title: Video Editor for YouTube Real Estate
description:
We are looking for a video editor for long-form YouTube videos (8–15 minutes) about city living, market trends, and neighborhood guides. We need someone who can match a very specific, high-production style.



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE POST CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING.



THE STYLE WE NEED:

- Cinematic talking-head footage as the spine of the video

- A punchy hook in the first 10 seconds — bold kinetic text animations with word-by-word emphasis (mixed white/accent color), tightly synced to the voiceover

- Heavy use of b-roll: drone shots, city footage, property interiors, cut to the narration

- Clean color grading with a warm, premium feel

- Licensed background music layered under the VO, with dynamic ducking

- Subtle sound design (whooshes, impacts) on transitions and text reveals

- Clean animated captions/subtitles throughout

- Simple motion graphics for data points, stats, and map overlays

- Fast, tight pacing — no dead air, no long pauses



RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Edit raw talking-head footage into a finished, polished YouTube video

- Source and integrate b-roll, music, and sound effects

- Build the opening hook sequence with animated text

- Add captions, lower thirds, and light motion graphics

- Deliver in 4K, ready to upload

- Handle up to 2 rounds of revisions per video



REQUIREMENTS:

- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube content (please show it)

- Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or DaVinci Resolve + equivalent motion tools)

- Excellent sense of pacing, rhythm, and music sync

- Understanding of YouTube retention editing

- Reliable computer and stable internet

- Good written English and responsive communication



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY:

Send your application by
 to 
 with the subject line: BLUEPRINT - Video Editor



Applications missing any of the following will not be reviewed:



1. Share 2–3 links to long-form YouTube videos YOU personally edited. Portfolio reels and short-form/TikTok work will not be considered.

2. For each link, tell us specifically what you did on it (full edit, motion graphics only, captions only, etc.)

 with the word BLUEPRINT so we know you read this post in full.

title: Remote Fleet Operations Manager — U.S. Car Rental Company
description:
Remote Fleet Operations Manager — U.S. Car Rental Company



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Eastern Time



We are a rapidly growing U.S.-based private car rental company.



We currently own 17 vehicles and are actively expanding, with a goal of reaching 50 vehicles by December 2026.



We are looking for a highly capable Fleet Operations Manager who can help the owner organize, systemize, and eventually manage the day-to-day operation of the company.



This is NOT a basic Virtual Assistant position.



We want someone who thinks like an operator, solves problems independently, builds systems, and wants to grow into a leadership position.



YOUR ROLE



You will work directly with the owner initially and progressively take responsibility for daily fleet operations.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing customer inquiries and following up with rental leads

*
 Marketplace/Messenger customer communication

* Screening and qualifying prospective renters

* Coordinating reservations and vehicle availability

* Managing rental agreements and customer documentation

* Tracking rental payments, security deposits, extensions, and overdue balances

* Managing late renters and overdue vehicles according to company procedures

* Coordinating vehicle pickups and returns

* Tracking every vehicle’s operational status

* Coordinating mechanics, repair shops, towing, cleaning, and other vendors

* Tracking preventative maintenance, mileage, registration, and insurance status

* Tracking tolls, tickets, parking violations, and renter responsibility

* Managing accident/damage documentation and assisting with claims administration

* Maintaining accurate customer and vehicle records

* Maintaining the company’s fleet dashboard and CRM

* Creating and improving Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Producing a concise daily operations report for the owner

* Eventually helping hire, train, and supervise additional support staff



WHO WE WANT



Direct experience with Turo, private car rentals, vehicle fleets, dealerships, automotive operations, or rideshare rental fleets is strongly preferred.



You should have:



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong organizational skills

* Strong customer-service skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Experience with Google Sheets

* Experience with CRM or operations-management software

* Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time

* Ability to manage multiple problems simultaneously

* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills

* Ability to create clear processes and SOPs

* Confidence communicating with customers, mechanics, vendors, and team members



Most importantly:



We want someone who takes ownership.



When something goes wrong, your first response should be:



“How do I solve this?”



—not—



“Let me ask the owner what to do.”



There will always be situations that require escalation, but the goal is to build an operation that does not depend on the owner handling every routine decision.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This is intended to be a long-term position.



As the fleet grows, the successful candidate can grow into:



Head of Fleet Operations



You may eventually supervise customer-service VAs, administrative staff, and local fleet personnel.



We are building the management team now while the company is growing.



COMPENSATION



$5–$7 USD/hour to start, depending on experience and ability.



Full-time opportunity.



Performance bonuses and compensation growth will be available as responsibilities and fleet size increase.



Exceptional candidates with substantial fleet-management experience may be considered above this range.



?



HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send only a generic résumé or copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with the words:



“FLEET 50”



Then answer ALL of the following questions.



1. CAR RENTAL EXPERIENCE



Have you personally worked for:



* Turo host

* Private car-rental company

* Rideshare/gig-driver rental fleet

* Dealership

* Fleet-management company

* Automotive company



If yes, explain:



How many vehicles were in the fleet?



What exactly were YOU responsible for?



Be specific.



2. SOFTWARE & SYSTEMS



Tell us which of the following you have personally used:



* Turo

*
 Marketplace

*
 Messenger

* Google Sheets

* CRM systems

* Fleet-management software

* GPS tracking systems

* Payment-processing systems

* Project-management software

* Automation software



Tell us what you actually did with each system.



3. OPERATIONS TEST



Imagine you are responsible for a 20-car rental fleet.



It is Friday at 7:30 PM.



Vehicle #8: Supposed to return at 6:00 PM. The renter isn’t responding.



Problem: Another customer is scheduled to receive Vehicle #8 Saturday at 9:00 AM.



At the same time:



Vehicle #12: The renter reports that a warning light just appeared.



And:



Vehicle #4: The renter wants to extend another seven days but has unpaid toll charges.



The owner is unavailable.



Explain exactly what you would do, in order.



We care more about your reasoning than having one “perfect” answer.



4. LATE PAYMENT TEST



A renter is two days late paying.



They keep saying:



“I’ll have the money tomorrow.”



The renter still has the vehicle and continues driving it.



Explain how you would manage the situation from beginning to resolution.



5. BUILDING SYSTEMS



You join a growing rental company where many procedures currently exist only in the owner’s head.



What are the first five systems/processes you would build or document?



Explain why you chose them.



6. SOP TEST



Write a short Standard Operating Procedure for:



Vehicle Return ? Vehicle Inspection ? Preparing Vehicle for the Next Renter



Keep it simple but operational.



7. VIDEO INTRODUCTION



Please provide a 2–3 minute video introduction explaining:



* Who you are

* Your relevant experience

* Why you believe you can help operate this company

* The largest fleet you’ve worked with

* One thing you would immediately improve when joining a rapidly growing rental fleet



IMPORTANT



We’re not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



We’re looking for someone who can eventually run the operation, build systems, solve problems, manage people, and help us scale from a small fleet into a professionally managed rental company.



If you’re looking for a long-term opportunity where your responsibilities and compensation can grow significantly with the company, we’d like to hear from you.



Remember to start your application with: FLEET 50

Creative needs with conversion goals

title: Workplace Activity Data Contributor (Project-Based)
description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.



Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.



In addition to our core business, Workstream is home to a small, fast-moving Robotics team focused on advancing the next generation of artificial intelligence and robotics. We partner with a leading AI and robotics company to produce high-quality, large-scale egocentric (first-person) video datasets that help train advanced AI models.



What We Offer

This is a project-based independent contractor opportunity designed to provide supplemental income. 



Earn USD $3.50 for every hour of approved video footage submitted.

Compensation is based on approved video submissions, not hours worked.

Videos are reviewed to ensure they meet Workstream's quality and project requirements before payment is approved.

Payment schedules and submission guidelines will be shared during onboarding.

Note: This opportunity is intended to complement your existing job or business. Contractors record authentic workplace activities as part of their normal work—not staged demonstrations—and are compensated only for footage accepted by Workstream.



About The Role

Workstream is collecting first-person video demonstrations of real-world physical tasks performed in commercial and workplace environments. These videos help develop and improve next-generation robotics, artificial intelligence (AI), computer vision, and automation technologies.



This is a project-based, independent contractor opportunity designed to provide supplemental income. Contractors record approved workplace activities using camera equipment provided by Workstream. Compensation is based on approved video submissions rather than hours worked.



As a Commercial Workplace Video Data Contributor, you'll record first-person videos while performing your regular work in an approved commercial or business environment. These recordings help train and improve robotics and AI technologies by capturing authentic workplace activities.



What You'll Do

Record first-person videos while performing your normal work tasks (no computer, screen-based, repetitive work).

Use the camera equipment provided by Workstream.

Follow recording, safety, and privacy guidelines.

Obtain approval from Workstream and permission from your workplace before recording.

Upload videos through Workstream's platform.

Maintain recording equipment and apply feedback to improve future submissions.

Examples of Tasks



You may record activities such as:

Operating tools or equipment

Organizing or restocking inventory

Picking, packing, assembling, or preparing items

Cleaning work areas or equipment

Moving or storing materials

Maintenance, repair, fabrication, or construction work

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Location: Manila, Philippines

Work arrangement: Full-time, work from home initially, transitioning to our future Manila City office

Reports to: Philippines Office Manager



About Elite Trades Australia

Elite Trades Australia is a Melbourne-based electrical and plumbing services company delivering residential, commercial, government, maintenance and energy-efficiency projects across Victoria. Our work includes electrical and plumbing services, hot-water and heat-pump installations, property upgrades, maintenance and project delivery.

We coordinate internal field teams and subcontractors through disciplined job-management, scheduling, compliance and documentation systems. Accuracy, ownership and timely escalation are essential to keeping our field operations running effectively.



About the Role

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-focused Field Service Admin Coordinator to support the administration, scheduling, documentation, and operational coordination of jobs for an Australian trades business.

You will manage jobs from the time a purchase order or confirmed booking is received through to job creation, desktop auditing, scheduling, field-worker allocation, subcontractor confirmation, variation processing, billing support, and records maintenance.

This position requires someone who takes ownership of unresolved matters, maintains accurate records, and ensures every job is properly prepared before its scheduled attendance date.



Key Responsibilities

• Same-day job creation. Create ServiceM8 job cards on the day a purchase order or confirmed booking is received; apply the correct status, including “Pending Details” where information is incomplete; and update required stakeholder and scheduling trackers without delay.

• Data integrity. Accurately enter and maintain customer, property, retailer, purchase-order and job information; create or update retailer records; and correct errors or changes immediately.

• Document control. Attach purchase orders, assessment reports, photographs, certificates and supporting evidence to the correct ServiceM8 job before it progresses, keeping ServiceM8 and all contractual trackers aligned.

• Pre-attendance desktop audits. Complete the final desktop review by the business day before attendance, covering clearances, switchboards, access, additional works, modifications, Location Insights and double-storey properties.

• Job readiness and allocation. Confirm standard jobs are booked and ready, assign next-day work across the required platforms, and verify that field workers and subcontractors can access their jobs on mobile devices.

• Escalation and queue ownership. Escalate missing, inaccessible or unassigned jobs—and any unresolved information or documentation—in the operational group and office chat; follow each issue through to resolution; and maintain the Runabout Waiting and Assigned Lists.

• Subcontractor administration. Obtain written confirmation before each subcontracted job, record it in WhatsApp, ServiceM8 and Excel, and enter the job in the Contractor Payment Tracker.

• Invoice readiness. Complete a final documentation check and prepare customer or retailer invoices only when the job record is complete, validating all charges against the purchase order, approved variations and completed works.

• Billing control. Maintain invoicing, accounts-receivable and billing trackers; identify completed but uninvoiced work; progress exceptions to resolution; and assist with invoice follow-up and outstanding-account reporting.

• Bookkeeping records. Maintain approved supplier and subcontractor records, contractor-payment information, supporting documents and basic transaction records, and provide the external bookkeeper with documentation required for reconciliations.

• Variation administration. Prepare draft variation documentation with the required photographs, reports and approvals, then update approved variations in ServiceM8 and the relevant billing records.

• Contractor invoice checks. Check subcontractor invoices against approved jobs, rates and variations, and escalate missing approvals, inconsistent amounts or incomplete evidence to the Philippines Office Manager.

• Compliance support. Organise certificates, photographs, audit evidence and job records, and flag missing, incorrect or inconsistent documentation before the job or invoice progresses.

• File and exception reporting. Maintain organised electronic files using consistent naming conventions and produce daily or weekly reports covering incomplete jobs, uninvoiced work, missing documents and unresolved data issues.

• Operational cover. Provide backup administrative support to the scheduling and customer-service functions during peak periods or staff leave.



Skills and Experience

• Proven experience in administration, job scheduling, operations coordination, or field-service support.

• Strong data-entry, Excel or Google Sheets, and record-management skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and written English.

• Experience with ServiceM8, Runabout, bookkeeping, or similar systems is desirable.

• Ability to manage deadlines, identify errors, escalate issues, and maintain accurate records.

• Reliable computer, stable internet, and availability during Australian business hours.



Performance Expectations

• New jobs must be created and entered on the same day they are received.

• Scheduled jobs must be fully audited and administratively ready by the day before attendance.

• Changes must be updated across all relevant systems immediately.

• Missing information, documents, assignments, or platform-access issues must be escalated promptly.

• No job should progress without the required documentation, checks, and confirmations.

• All operational, subcontractor, variation, billing, and bookkeeping records must remain accurate and current.



How to Apply and Location Details

Applicants should live in Tabuk City or within a practical commuting distance of Tabuk City.

This position will begin as a work-from-home role. The successful applicant must be willing and able to transition to working from our future Tabuk City office when it opens.



Please provide:

1. Your updated résumé.

2. A link to a 2–3-minute recorded video introduction using Loom, Google Drive, or a similar platform. In your video, please explain:

o Your previous administration or operations experience.

o Your experience with job scheduling, data entry, Excel, bookkeeping, or contractor coordination.

o Any experience using ServiceM8 or similar job-management software.

o How you maintain accuracy when managing multiple jobs and deadlines.

o Why you believe you are suitable for this position.

3. A screenshot of your current internet speed.

4. Details of your computer and backup internet or power arrangements.

5. A Photo of your workstation. At least 2 screens required.

6. Your availability to work Australian business hours.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
THE ROLE

You will work on the full stack of both client-facing systems (marketing sites, HubSpot integrations, custom web apps) and our internal SaaS products (feature development, bug fixes, and shipping).

You will report to our Head of Development, based in the Philippines, and collaborate daily with product, design, and marketing teams across time zones.

If you are not proactive, this role will not work. If you wait to be told what to do next, you will fall behind. We are looking for someone who ships, thinks about the user, and does not need to be pushed.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Frontend:

• Build modern, responsive interfaces in React, Vue, or similar

• Deep, hands-on CSS and HTML, including work with modern frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap)

• Convert design mockups (Figma) into production-ready components

• Optimize for performance and cross-browser reliability

Backend:

• Build and maintain PHP applications in modern MVC frameworks

• Design and evolve APIs (REST, and increasingly integrations with AI services)

• Work with relational databases: schema design, queries, performance

• Ship features from planning to production, including QA

Product and Client Work:

• Contribute to our internal SaaS products (Bizman and others), from feature planning to release

• Build and maintain WordPress sites and HubSpot integrations for clients

• Collaborate on the AI-augmented direction we are taking across our products and client work

Collaboration:

• Participate in dev team meetings (Monday alignment, Friday review and a daily follow-up)

• Write clear documentation for the code you ship

• Give and receive code review actively, not passively



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

• Currently based in the Philippines

• Fluent in English (spoken and written)

• 2+ years of full-stack development experience

• Strong CSS and HTML, with real experience in modern frameworks

• Strong JavaScript, with hands-on production experience in React or Vue

• Strong PHP, with hands-on production experience in MVC frameworks

• Solid understanding of relational databases and API design

• Working knowledge of Git and version control

• High-level communication skills (this is critical for our distributed team)



NICE TO HAVE

• Laravel experience

• GitHub proficiency (pull requests, code review workflows, GitHub Actions)

• WordPress development experience

• HubSpot ecosystem experience (workflows, custom modules, HubDB)

• Experience integrating AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into web applications

• Comfort working with AI-augmented dev tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot)

• SaaS product experience (not just agency work)



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS

• You ship features on time and to spec, on both client and product work

• Your code is clean enough that the team does not need to rewrite it

• You raise your hand early when something is unclear or blocked, rather than going silent

• You contribute ideas, not just execution

• Your Head of Development can rely on you without micromanaging



COMPENSATION

Base Salary: Starting at 40,000 PHP per month, with a clear growth path to 60,000 PHP based on performance and contribution over time

Performance bonuses available based on delivery and product success

Vacation days, holidays, and sick days



PERSONALITY FIT

We are not looking for someone who codes in silence and disappears.

You must be:

• Extremely proactive

• Comfortable pushing back and challenging requirements when they don't make sense

• Independent but collaborative

• Curious, especially about AI and how it changes how we build

• Comfortable communicating in English with product, design, and clients

• Hungry to grow into a senior technical role



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

This role has a growth path. Strong performance can lead to:

• Ownership of a specific product area (Bizman, SmartCal, or a new product)

• Leadership of a small squad within the dev team

• Direct influence on our AI-integrated product direction

description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.



Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Workstream is looking for an Operations Manager for Global Data Operations. In this role, you will lead the most critical data-gathering initiative for Workstream’s robotics division. You will partner closely with the Recruiting and People Ops teams to drive high-volume participant acquisition, while taking direct ownership of the ongoing management and data output quality of hundreds of participants helping robots “learn” how to interact with the world. Your goal is to ensure we hit our weekly footage targets while maintaining compliance with data quality standards.



This isn’t just a standard operations role; you will be helping build the foundation for the future of robotics. You will manage a truly global operation that bridges the gap between high-volume data collection and high-level AI research.



Please note that this role will initially be remote, but is expected to transition to office-based once we establish our local office. The Operations Manager will also play a key role in helping set up and operationalize the office locally.



Day in the Life



Team Management & Leadership

Lead and mentor a large, distributed team of Video Data Contributors and potentially a small team of Team Leads or Quality Auditors.

Lab Management: Oversee a physical Workstream Lab, managing office-based team members who utilize complex multi-camera wearable setups to capture high-fidelity data.

Conduct weekly "Office Hours" and Q&A sessions to troubleshoot contributor issues and provide feedback on recording techniques.

Monitor contributor engagement and retention, implementing strategies to reduce churn in a month-to-month contract environment.



High-Volume Recruitment & Onboarding

Technical Guidance: Collaborate with the Recruiting team to provide specific technical criteria for candidates, ensuring they possess the right hardware and high attention to detail.

Onboarding: Partner with People Ops to facilitate a seamless transition, ensuring contributors are immediately integrated into filming and data protocols.

Equipment Verification: Coordinate with Recruiting on the verification of equipment (head-straps and camera specs) to ensure every new participant is project-ready.



Data Quality & Feedback Loop

Quality Assurance: Lead a team of reviewers to audit footage for "usability" (hand/arm movement vs. idle activities).

Continuous Improvement: Update the "Guidelines Presentation" and training materials based on common failure points in the footage (e.g., poor lighting or incorrect camera angles).

Technical Troubleshooting: Act as the final escalation point for hardware compatibility issues or Google Drive upload failures.



Financial & Compliance Oversight

Compensation: Manage the complex tiered compensation structure and bonus payouts.

Payroll Partnership: Ensure all monthly payments via Deel are accurate and submitted within payout cycles.

Data Privacy: Ensure strict adherence to compliance guidelines, ensuring no personal information is captured in the uploaded data.



Who You Are

Management: 6+ years in Operations Management, specifically leading distributed or "gig" workforces.

Technical Proficiency: You are technically savvy and comfortable managing/troubleshooting multi-camera hardware. You must be able to master and teach the technical nuances of multi-angle recording to ensure data integrity.

Global Operations: Experience managing teams across the Philippines and the US, including understanding the cultural and logistical differences in both markets.

Analytical Mindset: Ability to look at "Unusable Footage" data and pinpoint exactly where the training or the recruitment filter is failing.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience in AI Data Labeling or Computer Vision data collection.

Experience with hardware logistics (inventorying and shipping head-straps or smartphones).

A background in BPO Management or Marketplace Operations (e.g., Uber, DoorDash, TaskRabbit).

Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.



Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Pay wired directly to your bank account

Annual Bonus

Flexible PTO

Enjoy company time off during some of the major US and PH Holidays

Company-issued Device

Career fast track for performers and internal mobility

Actively communicating with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers regarding client progress

Who You Are

You love working with customers and thrive in delighting customers

Detail oriented

title: Luxury Lifestyle Content Researcher / Instagram VA
description:
I am looking for a detail-oriented Instagram VA / Content Researcher who can help me find and curate luxury lifestyle content for an Instagram profile.



The main responsibility will be researching Instagram and other approved sources, finding relevant visual content, evaluating it according to specific guidelines, organizing it, and preparing batches for review.



This is NOT a typical social media manager position. The main focus is content research, visual curation, and organization.



TARGET LIFESTYLE AND AESTHETIC



The profile represents the lifestyle of a sophisticated man approximately 30–35 years old.



All selected content should feel consistent with this demographic and lifestyle.



The content should look natural and spontaneous, as if it was casually captured by a person using an iPhone during everyday life.



IMPORTANT:



The content should NOT look like professional photography, a commercial campaign, a fashion photoshoot, stock photography, or highly produced influencer content.



Preferred characteristics:



– Natural iPhone photography

– Natural lighting

– Casual framing

– Candid moments

– First-person / POV perspective

– Faceless lifestyle content

– Realistic everyday situations

– Understated luxury

– Authentic-looking environments

– Minimal editing

– Natural imperfections



The goal is not simply to find expensive-looking photos.



The goal is to find content that looks like a real moment from the life of a successful man in his early 30s.



MAIN CONTENT CATEGORIES



TRAVEL AND AVIATION



– Private jets

– Business class

– First class

– Airport lounges

– Luxury airports

– Airplane interiors

– Airplane window views

– Luggage

– Private aviation



YACHTS AND BOATS



– Luxury yachts

– Yacht decks

– Marinas

– Sailing

– Boat interiors

– Sunset on a yacht

– POV yacht content

– Beach clubs

– Boat trips



CARS



– Luxury cars

– Supercars

– Premium SUVs

– Car interiors

– Steering wheel POV

– Driving

– Parking at luxury locations

– Car keys

– Casual car content



HOTELS AND REAL ESTATE



– Luxury hotels

– Hotel rooms

– Hotel bathrooms

– Hotel breakfasts

– Hotel balconies

– Hotel pools

– Luxury villas

– Luxury apartments

– Rooftop views

– Hotel corridors and common areas



RESTAURANTS AND NIGHTLIFE



– High-end restaurants

– Restaurant tables

– Dinner

– Cocktails

– Rooftop bars

– Beach clubs

– Nightlife

– Luxury dining

– Casual evening situations



FASHION AND PERSONAL ITEMS



– Watches

– Shoes

– Sunglasses

– Tailored clothing

– Luggage

– Accessories

– Premium everyday items

– Understated luxury products



FITNESS AND WELLNESS



– Premium gyms

– Hotel gyms

– Fitness clubs

– Spas

– Wellness

– Yoga

– Stretching

– Swimming pools

– Post-workout lifestyle



LUXURY DESTINATIONS



– Monaco

– Dubai

– Ibiza

– Mykonos

– St. Tropez

– Cannes

– Milan

– Paris

– London

– Singapore

– Tokyo

– Maldives

– Bali

– Amalfi Coast

– Lake Como

– French Riviera

– Greek Islands



POV / FACELESS CONTENT



This is one of the most important categories.



Examples include:



– Hands

– Wrist and watch

– Feet

– Restaurant table

– Coffee

– Hotel breakfast

– Airplane window

– Yacht deck

– Car interior

– Steering wheel

– Hotel room

– Hotel balcony

– Pool

– Beach

– Gym equipment

– Suitcase

– Airport lounge

– City views

– Dinner table

– First-person travel experiences



EVERYDAY LUXURY



Do not focus only on obvious displays of wealth.



Natural everyday moments are especially valuable.



Examples:



– Coffee in a luxury hotel

– Breakfast

– Laptop on a hotel desk

– Hotel room

– Hotel hallway

– Elevator

– Suitcase

– Airport lounge

– Restaurant table

– Car interior

– City view

– Gym

– Balcony

– Casual evening drink

– Walking through a luxury location



The environment should communicate the lifestyle without the image trying too hard to show wealth.



LIFESTYLE CONTINUITY



When researching content, think about how several pieces could work together as one story.



For example:



Morning:

Hotel room -> Coffee -> Gym -> Breakfast



Afternoon:

Car -> Restaurant -> Marina -> Yacht



Evening:

Sunset -> Cocktail -> Dinner -> Hotel



It is highly valuable to find several pieces of content that can logically belong together.



Avoid random combinations of completely unrelated locations.



CONTENT VARIETY



Do not submit large batches consisting of only one type of content.



For example, do not submit 20 yacht photos or 20 supercar photos.



The content should be balanced across:



– Travel

– Hotels

– Restaurants

– Cars

– Aviation

– Yachts

– Fitness

– Fashion

– Everyday lifestyle

– POV

– Faceless content

– Luxury locations



CONTENT RESEARCH



Instagram will be one of the main research platforms.



Use:



– Instagram profiles

– Instagram Stories

– Instagram Reels

– Instagram location pages

– Geotags

– Relevant hashtags

– Hotels

– Restaurants

– Marinas

– Airports

– Luxury venues

– Travel destinations

– Lifestyle creators



Look beyond major influencers and professional photographers.



Smaller creators and ordinary users can often provide much more natural-looking content.



For third-party content intended for publication, prioritize content that is legally reusable, explicitly permitted for reposting, licensed, or otherwise cleared for use.



CONTENT SELECTION CRITERIA



Before selecting any piece of content, ask:



Does it look natural?

Does it look like it could have been captured casually on an iPhone?

Does it fit the lifestyle of a man approximately 30–35 years old?

Does it feel sophisticated and understated?

Does it look like a real-life moment rather than a professional photoshoot?

Does it fit the overall visual identity?

Could it logically fit together with other content?

Is the quality good enough for Instagram?

Is the source and intended use appropriate?

Would this look believable next to the rest of the profile?



If the answer to several of these questions is NO, do not submit the content.



CONTENT TRACKING AND ORGANIZATION



You will be responsible for keeping an accurate record of the researched content and saving selected material according to the approved format.



Each piece of content should be properly categorized and associated with the relevant source, location, content type, and usage status.



The system should make it easy to identify:



– Source

– Location

– Category

– Content type

– Review status

– Usage status

– Permission / usage status



DAILY WORKFLOW



Research Instagram and other approved sources.

Find relevant profiles and content.

Select the strongest pieces.

Evaluate them according to the aesthetic requirements.

Check that the content fits the target male lifestyle.

Check that it feels natural rather than professionally produced.

Check the source and usage status.

Save the selected content according to the approved format.

Keep the content record updated.

Submit a batch for review.

Apply feedback to future research.



TEST TASK



Before hiring, candidates will complete a test assignment.



The test assignment is to find 20 pieces of Instagram content that fit all requirements described above.



The 20 pieces should demonstrate variety.



A good test batch would include:



– 2-3 photos of a guy of a specified body type on the luxuty yacht / business jet / first class flight / near luxury car. That person should not be a famous profile.

– 1-2 hotel / lifestyle pieces

– 1-2 travel / aviation pieces

– 1-2 cars

– 1-2 restaurants / nightlife

– 1-2 yachts / beach / marina pieces

– Additional pieces from other relevant luxury lifestyle categories



The exact distribution is not important. Overall quality, variety, and consistency are more important.



The test will be evaluated based on:



– Quality of research

– Ability to find non-obvious content

– Natural iPhone-like aesthetic

– Understanding of the target demographic

– Consistency

– Attention to detail

– Ability to distinguish authentic-looking lifestyle content from staged content

– Organization

– Source and usage awareness



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You should:



– Use Instagram extensively

– Understand Instagram aesthetics

– Have a strong eye for visual quality

– Understand luxury lifestyle content

– Be comfortable researching locations and profiles

– Have excellent attention to detail

– Be able to work independently

– Communicate clearly in English

– Be comfortable working with Google Drive and similar tools

– Be reliable and consistent

– Be able to follow detailed visual guidelines



Previous experience as an Instagram VA, content researcher, social media VA, influencer VA, or content curator is a plus.



IMPORTANT



I am NOT looking for someone who simply searches for "luxury lifestyle" and selects the first attractive images.



I am looking for someone who can curate a consistent and believable visual world.



The key skill is understanding the difference between:



"This is an expensive-looking photo."



AND



"This looks like a real moment from the life of a successful man in his early 30s."



The second type of content is what we are looking for.
