title: Senior E-commerce SEO & Shopify Specialist
description:
SENIOR E-COMMERCE SEO & SHOPIFY SPECIALIST

Full-time, remote, long-term. $1,200 to $1,500/month depending on experience.



ABOUT US



Buzzy Seeds is a US garden brand. We make grow kits that double as gifts:

simple enough that a first-timer actually succeeds, nice enough that you

would happily give one. We sell on Shopify, Amazon and Walmart, with 86

ASINs on Amazon alone and a wider catalogue beyond it.



We are running a three-year plan to grow e-commerce revenue significantly,

and organic search is the core lever. You are the first specialist hire on

this team. You own organic end to end, and as we grow you help train the

people who join after you.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Technical SEO on our Shopify store. Our latest audit shows roughly 1,500

  errors and 4,500 warnings. Clearing those and keeping them clear is your

  first project.

- Site speed, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, canonicals, structured data,

  internal linking, redirect hygiene.

- Product pages: structure, on-page copy, schema, conversion elements.

- Shopify theme edits and app choices. You make the changes yourself, you

  do not write tickets for someone else.

- AEO and GEO: being findable and citable in AI search, not only Google.

- SEO listing copy on all three channels. Each has its own search logic and

  we expect you to know the difference.

- Blog strategy and production, keyword research, backlinks.

- Weekly reporting on organic traffic, rankings and organic revenue.

- From month two, joining our weekly e-commerce meeting and presenting your

  own numbers.



WHAT WE NEED



- 4+ years hands-on technical SEO, at least 2 of them on Shopify. Hands-on

  means you made the changes, not that you wrote the recommendation.

- You have personally cleared a large technical backlog on a live store and

  can show what changed as a result.

- Comfortable in Shopify theme code: Liquid, HTML, CSS, basic JS.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You will write customer-facing copy

  and present your own numbers in our weekly meeting.

- You use AI tools as a normal part of your workflow. Tell us which ones and

  what you use each for.

- You come with ideas. We do not want someone who waits for a task list. We

  want someone who tells us what we are missing.

- When you apply, type the word STROOPWAFELSCHARNIER in the field that asks

  for it. It tells us you read this all the way down.

- Willing to document your work, because you will train the people who join

  after you.



NICE TO HAVE



Amazon or Walmart listing experience. GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs or

Semrush, Screaming Frog. Garden, home or seasonal consumer products.



HOURS AND TIME ZONES



I am in the Netherlands, Central European Time. Our office and part of the

team are in Pennsylvania, US Eastern Time.



Day to day you work with me, so we need overlap with 09:00 to 17:00 Central

European Time. You do not need to be online for all of it, and you are free

to keep working after I log off.



Once a week we have an e-commerce meeting with the US team at 14:00 Central

European Time, which is 08:00 US Eastern. From your second month you join

that meeting and present your own numbers. If you are in the Philippines,

that is 20:00 your time, once a week.



WHAT WE OFFER



- $1,200 to $1,500/month depending on experience. Full-time, long-term,

  paid monthly.

- Direct working relationship with the e-commerce lead. No layers, no

  committee, fast decisions.

- Real ownership of a channel, with a budget and clear KPIs.

- A backlog that is already mapped, so you produce from week one.

- Written procedures, so you are never guessing what good looks like.

- Room to grow. This is the first hire on a team we are building out this

  year.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not reply here with a CV. We will not read it.



Fill in this form instead: 



It takes about 20 minutes. Two of the questions ask you to actually look at

our store, 
, and one asks for a two minute screen recording

where you explain one of your findings out loud. That is deliberate, and it

is the job.



We read every answer ourselves, and everyone who completes the form hears

back from us either way.

title: Creative streetwear and apparel graphic designer
description:
# Melodik Threadz Co™

## Streetwear Graphic Designer / Illustrator — Creative VA



### About the Role



Melodik Threadz Co™ is looking for a talented Streetwear Graphic Designer / Illustrator who can take original concepts and transform them into high-quality, production-ready apparel designs.



This is not primarily a Canva, social-media flyer, or administrative position.



We are looking for someone with genuine creative ability who can receive a concept, understand the meaning behind it, develop a strong visual direction, and execute professional artwork suitable for a premium streetwear brand.



The owner will serve as Creative Director, providing the concepts, meaning, references, feedback, and final approval. Your responsibility will be to bring those ideas to life visually.



---



## What You'll Be Creating



Projects may include:



- Original T-shirt graphics

- Hoodies and crewneck graphics

- Front, back, and sleeve artwork

- Streetwear illustrations

- Custom typography

- Vintage/distressed graphics

- Luxury streetwear concepts

- Character-based artwork

- Symbolic and metaphorical artwork

- Badges, emblems, and supporting graphics

- Garment mockups

- Print-ready production files



Many concepts will begin as an idea rather than completed artwork.



For example, you may receive a concept, meaning, mood, and several visual references. You will be expected to use your artistic ability to develop that information into an original composition rather than simply copying the references.



---



# What We Need From You



### 1. Strong Creative Interpretation



You must be able to take an abstract idea and develop it visually.



We do not want someone who needs every element, position, font, and detail explained before beginning.



We want someone who can think creatively and contribute ideas while still following the Creative Director's vision.



### 2. Strong Streetwear Understanding



You should understand current and classic streetwear aesthetics, including:



- Oversized graphic compositions

- Vintage-inspired graphics

- Premium typography

- Distressing and texture

- Placement and proportions

- Front/back relationships

- Sleeve graphics

- Garment color interaction

- Visual hierarchy



The artwork should look like something consumers would actually purchase—not simply artwork placed on a shirt.



### 3. Illustration & Graphic Design Ability



Strong skills in:



Adobe Photoshop — Required



Adobe Illustrator — Strongly Preferred



Additional illustration software is acceptable.



Canva may be used for certain marketing projects, but Canva alone is not sufficient for this position.



### 4. Production-Ready Artwork



You must understand how to prepare artwork for apparel production.



Final files may need to include:



- High-resolution artwork

- 300 DPI

- Transparent PNG

- True transparent backgrounds

- Vector files when appropriate

- PSD/AI working files

- Correct print dimensions

- Clean edges

- No unwanted backgrounds, shadows, or artifacts

- Proper color management

- Separate front/back/sleeve graphics when required



Artwork must be suitable for professional DTF, DTG, screen printing, embroidery, or other garment-production methods, depending on the project.



---



# Our Creative Philosophy



Melodik Threadz Co™ designs frequently begin with music, culture, language, emotions, experiences, and everyday expressions.



However, our goal is usually not to illustrate an idea literally.



We prefer visual metaphors.



The artwork should make someone look at the shirt, understand something deeper is happening, and potentially discover another meaning after looking at it again.



Originality is extremely important.



---



# Important Brand Rules



You will receive detailed brand standards once hired, but several principles are important from the beginning:



- Do not copy another clothing brand's artwork.

- References are for direction and inspiration, not duplication.

- Avoid generic-looking AI artwork.

- Avoid artwork that looks obviously AI-generated.

- Typography must feel intentional and professional.

- Small text must remain readable.

- Brand spelling must always be accurate.

- Avoid unnecessary elements just to fill space.

- Every element should contribute to the concept.

- Designs should feel premium and commercially wearable.



AI tools may be used to assist the creative process when approved, but the finished artwork must be professionally designed, refined, edited, and production-ready.



---



# Creative Workflow



Our normal process will be:



STEP 1 — Concept



Creative Director provides the idea, meaning, references, garment color, and general direction.



STEP 2 — Interpretation



Designer develops the visual direction and composition.



STEP 3 — Initial Design



Designer submits the first concept for review.



STEP 4 — Feedback



Creative Director provides revisions and direction.



STEP 5 — Final Artwork



Designer completes the approved design.



STEP 6 — Production Files



Designer prepares the required print-ready files.



STEP 7 — Mockup



Once artwork is approved, the design may be presented on the appropriate garment mockup.



---



# What We Are NOT Looking For



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily:



- Canva templates

- Social-media flyers

- Basic logo creation

- Simple photo editing

- Premade T-shirt templates

- Copying Pinterest designs

- Generating an AI image and submitting it without professional editing



Those skills can be useful, but they are not enough for this position.



We need an actual designer and visual problem-solver.



---



# Portfolio Requirements



Please send examples of your strongest work.



We especially want to see:



- Streetwear

- Apparel graphics

- Illustration

- Typography

- Poster-style compositions

- Character artwork

- Vintage graphics

- Complex Photoshop compositions



If you have worked with clothing brands previously, please identify which designs were actually created by you.



---



# Paid Design Test



Final candidates may be asked to complete a paid creative test.



Every candidate will receive the same concept and general instructions.



We will evaluate:



Creativity — Did you bring something original to the concept?



Interpretation — Did you understand the idea instead of simply illustrating the words?



Design Quality — Does it look professional?



Streetwear Appeal — Would someone actually buy and wear it?



Typography — Does the typography complement the artwork?



Attention to Detail — Is the artwork polished?



Communication — Did you understand and respond appropriately to feedback?



Technical Execution — Can the artwork actually be manufactured?



Originality — Does it feel unique rather than copied or obviously AI-generated?



---



# When Applying, Please Send



1. Your name and location

2. Your portfolio

3. Examples of apparel/streetwear designs

4. Software you use

5. Years of graphic-design experience

6. Whether you use Photoshop

7. Whether you use Illustrator

8. Your experience preparing artwork for garment printing

9. Your experience with DTF, DTG, screen printing, or embroidery

10. Your monthly full-time rate OR preferred per-design rate

11. Your normal working hours and time zone

12. Your computer specifications

13. Your internet speed

14. Your earliest available start date



Please also answer:



If someone gives you an idea but doesn't tell you exactly what the finished artwork should look like, are you comfortable developing the creative direction yourself?



---



# What Success Looks Like



The ideal designer eventually understands the Melodik Threadz Co™ visual language well enough that the Creative Director can explain an idea and you can take it from:



Concept ? Interpretation ? Artwork ? Revision ? Production File



without needing every creative decision made for you.



We are looking for someone interested in developing a long-term creative relationship with the brand, not simply completing random graphics.



Brand: Melodik Threadz Co™  

Position: Streetwear Graphic Designer / Illustrator — Creative VA  

Work Type: Remote

title: Marketing Assistant (VA) — SEO, Influencer & Paid Media Support
description:
## Role Overview



We are a fast-growing US-based ecommerce brand generating over $50M in annual sales, selling globally through Shopify, Amazon, and Walmart.



We are hiring for a long-term position and you will be joining an established team of 13 full-time team members in the Philippines already working with us.

This is a full-time role with complete training provided. You will work directly with our Head of Growth to support our marketing across SEO, paid ads, influencers, affiliates, and reporting. You will help keep our campaigns organized, our content optimized, and our data accurate.



If you enjoy structured work, staying organized, and digital marketing, this role is a great long-term opportunity.



## Compensation + Schedule



- $1,300 USD per month

- Full-time: 40 hours per week

- Equivalent to $8.125/hour

- Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Yearly Salary Increases & Bonus

- Full Training Provided



## How To Apply (IMPORTANT)



The ONLY way to apply is through this link:



** => 
/s/apb4look **



You must complete the assessment (takes up to 43 minutes max).



Your resume MUST be submitted through that link. Applications sent any other way will not be considered.



## Why We Require This Test



We receive hundreds of applicants, and resumes alone don't tell us who is truly smart, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems independently.



This assessment is the fastest and fairest way for us to filter applicants based on cognitive aptitude (how quickly you learn, follow instructions, and troubleshoot issues). That matters a lot in marketing work where accuracy and follow-through are everything.



If you do well, you'll be prioritized for a long-term, full-time role with $1,100/month pay, PTO, and full training.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### 1) SEO Support



- Assist with recurring technical SEO audits and maintain an issue tracker

- Help optimize product pages, collection pages, landing pages, and blogs

- Conduct keyword research and update titles, metadata, headings, internal links, alt text, and page copy

- Review blog and product content for search intent, structure, and SEO best practices

- Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and indexing



### 2) AI Search Optimization (AEO)

### 3) Paid Media Creative Operations

- Track deliverables, content status, links, codes, commissions, and performance

- Follow up on missing content and identify top-performing partners

- Route approved creator content into the paid media workflow



### 6) Reporting



- Support weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual marketing reports

- Gather data from Shopify, GA4, ad platforms, SEO tools, and creator/affiliate platforms

- Update dashboards and track metrics like revenue, ROAS, CPA, AOV, and conversion rate

- Flag data discrepancies, unusual trends, risks, and opportunities

- Help write short summaries of performance and next steps



## What We're Looking For



- Strong written English (near-native)

- 2–5 years of experience in digital marketing, ecommerce, SEO, content, influencer, or affiliate marketing

- Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and trackers

title: Client Response & Outreach Coordinator
description:
$8.75 per hour. 15 hours per week guaranteed, up to 20 as required.



About us



Ready2Exit is Australia's #1 business marketplace. We help business owners sell the companies they have spent twenty or thirty years building, and we help buyers acquire them properly. Most of the people we deal with are owner operators in trades, manufacturing and services, and for almost all of them, selling their business is the largest financial decision they will ever make.



I am Stuart Earl, Investor, M&A Advisor and leader of Australia's #1 business marketplace, with over 180,000 members.



We are a lean team, so you will work directly with me every day. What you do will show up directly in whether this business grows, and you will be able to watch that happen rather than take my word for it.



What we care about



Most business owners only sell a business once in their life. The industry does not serve them well, and the complaints are always the same: overpromising, no transparency, and no real buyer engagement. We built Ready2Exit to fix that, through preparation, honesty and doing the work properly.



Three things matter here more than anything else, and they will shape your day.



The first is speed. When a business owner calls us back, they are d
 in that moment whether we are serious people. A response forty five minutes later answers that question for them, and not in our favour.



The second is precision. Details carry real weight here. A wrong figure in a follow up
 can cost us a mandate that took months to win.



The third is honesty, and that includes honesty upwards. If I have made a mistake, I would rather hear it from you on the day than find it myself a fortnight later. The same applies in the other direction, and I will tell you directly when something is not right. Most people prefer working that way once they get used to it.



The role



You will own the front line of our communication, in both directions.



On one side, we run outreach campaigns and paid advertising that generate inbound calls, replies and form submissions. Those currently sit too long before anyone answers them, and it is the single biggest gap in our week. Closing that gap is the main reason this role exists.



On the other side, when we take on a business to sell, we build a list of buyers who might be a fit and we call them. This is warm work. You are ringing people who are actively looking to buy a business and telling them we have something worth a look.



Either way, you are the first person from Ready2Exit that a buyer or a business owner ever speaks to. You are the first voice of the business, and I treat that as one of the most important seats we have.



What you will be responsible for



The list below is in priority order, and the order genuinely matters. When two things compete, the one higher up wins. You will never need to ask my permission to drop something for an inbound call.



Inbound response. Every call, reply and form submission that comes from our campaigns. Qualify it against criteria I will give you, then book it, route it or close it out. Log every single one. You own that contact from the first touch through to a booked appointment.



Outbound buyer outreach. When we have a business on the market, you will work through a buyer list by phone and
, introduce the opportunity, and book the ones who are interested.



Callbacks and appointment booking. Returning missed calls and managing my diary around them.



Follow up. Post pitch follow up by
 and phone, on a cadence that you own and run without me reminding you, plus a weekly sweep of the pipeline for anything that has gone quiet.



Scheduling and rescheduling. Multi party, across time zones, with nothing dropped.



Administration. Onboarding
s and forms, and setting up document folders and permissions for live deals.



A good part of this role runs through our CRM, GoHighLevel. Experience with it is a real plus, though not a dealbreaker. If you are sharp and organised, it is quick to learn, and I will train you on it.



The standard



We are a high performance team and we thrive on overdelivering for our clients.



Fifteen minutes is the response time inside your window. We will measure it, and it will be your key measure of success.



Some mornings a campaign goes out and inbound will take your entire window. Other mornings it will be quiet and you will work through the background list. Both of those are normal and neither is a problem.



Outside your window we are honestly uncovered. Automation acknowledges people and you call them at the start of the next morning. We keep it honest about the size of our team.



Who I am looking for



You have worked somewhere the phone was the revenue. That might be a medical or dental front desk, service dispatch, roadside assistance, insurance claims intake, hotel reservations, client services at a broking firm, or an inbound queue with a target on the wall. What matters is that you have done this under a clock rather than at your own pace.



You will know the specific feeling of being halfway through careful work when something urgent lands. You can deal with the urgent thing, log it properly before you move on, and then go back and finish the careful work without breaking it. Most people manage two of those three. If you can do all three reliably, you are the person I want to talk to.



You will be speaking with Australian business owners, often people who have run their company for decades and do not suffer waffle. You need to be clear, warm and quick on your feet on the phone, able to hold a real conversation and sound like someone worth their time. If you are more comfortable behind
 than on a call, this will not suit you. Your written English matters too, because your
s go out under my name into live deals, so they need to read as if I wrote them.



You should get a kick out of a fast moving environment where things change without much warning. Some mornings the plan lasts ten minutes before a campaign lands or a deal moves. If that reads as chaos to you, this will not suit. If it reads as a good morning, we should talk. The people who do well here are comfortable in the unknown and would rather work something out than wait to be told.



Beyond that, I am looking for someone who catches the error nobody flagged, but who also knows when good enough is good enough and the deadline wins. Someone who can be given an outcome rather than a method and work the rest out. Someone who does not need me standing behind them. And someone with mature confidence, by which I mean you will tell me when you think I am wrong, once, with your reasoning, and then get on with the decision either way.



What you get



The rate is $8.75 per hour, with 15 hours guaranteed and up to 20 hours in weeks where the volume requires it, at the same rate.



On growth, I will be straight with you. Our volume is increasing and my intention is to take this role to 30 hours or more within three months. That happens when the workload supports it and when you have shown you can hold the standard. If both of those are true, the hours are there and the path to full time is real.



You will work directly with me, with no layers in between. You will get proper training, and you will learn how business acquisitions actually work, which is exposure that very few people in this market ever get. You will also be trusted with confidential financial information and live deals from early on, because I need this seat close to the real work.



Nice to have, though not required



SharePoint or OneDrive, exposure to Australian clients, or a background in professional services or finance.



How to apply



Please read this section properly. A large number of applications will be set aside for missing a step, and that is deliberate.



Begin your application with the word DISPATCH.

Complete the short application form here: 



It takes about five minutes and it is how I shortlist, so take a little care with it.



That is the whole first step. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short video and a conversation with me after that, so there is nothing to record right now.



I read every completed application and I reply to all of them, including the ones I am not taking forward.



Stuart Earl

Founder, Ready2Exit | Australia's #1 business marketplace

title: Operations Supervisor
description:
We are a growing US-based industrial manufacturing company (Louisiana). We buy bulk raw material, process and package it at our plant, and ship truckloads to customers across the US and Canada. Our Operations Manager currently runs the day-to-day himself, down to the smallest detail — we are hiring an Operations Supervisor to take most of that over. You will report directly to him.



This is NOT a VA role, and it is not a doing-the-tasks role. We already have a remote team in the Philippines that books freight, prepares shipping paperwork, invoices customers, and maintains our schedules and inventory sheets. They execute well — what they need is a manager. You will run daily operations the way the Operations Manager does today: set the plan, assign the work, verify it was done right, make the calls the team can’t make, and only bring him what truly needs him.



Your responsibilities

Run the daily operation:

• Set the load plan for the week — how many inbound raw-material trucks to bring in, which customer loads go out which day — and adjust it in real time when a truck cancels, runs late, or a customer changes plans

• Assign tasks to the remote team, chase status all day, and verify completion — no request goes unanswered, no commitment gets forgotten

• Approve or reject what the team brings you: freight quotes (set the price caps), forklift and vendor rentals, supply orders

• D
 which product lots go on each load based on weight limits and spec ranges, and untangle mix-ups quickly when bag numbers or weights don’t line up



Quality control (your manager’s biggest time sink today):

• Review the paperwork the team prepares — BOLs, packing lists, invoices, certificates — BEFORE it goes to a customer. Catch the wrong date, the missing line, the number that doesn’t match

• Keep the master schedule and inventory sheets accurate as the single source of truth, and think about the downstream effects of every change made to them

• Watch the plant through our camera system: confirm each shift’s production counts, safety gear, and procedures — and get problems corrected through the right on-site person instead of letting them slide

Manage the people:

• Give the remote team daily direction and hold them to our escalation workflow: they spot it, they resolve it, and management only hears how it ended

• Coordinate with our on-site US plant leads: weekend staffing, overtime and hours limits, daily checklists, keeping supplies from running out

• Verify payroll inputs — clock-ins, hours, pay rates — and question anything that looks off



US phone work (why your English matters):

title: Outbound Cold Caller – Australian B2B (Neutral/American Accent Required)
description:
We're an Australian AI automation agency. You'll be cold calling Australian business owners to book discovery meetings for us. Straight outbound dialling — no inbound, no chat support, no admin.



**READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING**



This role calls Australian business owners who hang up fast. You need to sound neutral or American on the phone. If your accent is noticeably Filipino, please don't apply.  We will reject you and it wastes both our time. Be honest with yourself here.



**What you'll do**

- 100+ outbound dials per day using our dialler 

- Work Manila 7am-3pm (Melbourne 9am-5pm). Non-negotiable, these are the only hours that work.

- Book qualified meetings into our calendar

- Log every call outcome in our CRM



**What you need**

- 2+ years outbound calling on a US, UK, or Australian account at a real business 

- Outbound sales or appointment setting specifically. nNot inbound customer service

- Wired internet connection (not WiFi) and a proper USB headset

- Backup power/internet arrangement

- You can handle rejection all day without going flat by 11am



**HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or you'll be rejected**



Do not send a CV or a generic intro video. Send a single audio recording, roughly 90 seconds, with these three parts:



1. **(30 sec)** Read this script word for word:

*"Hi, is that [name]? My name's ___, I was just reaching out because we build AI automation systems for Australian businesses to replace admin tasks. Have you looked at anything like that before?"*



2. **(30 sec)** In your own words, unscripted: why would a business owner want to take this call?



3. **(30 sec)** Unscripted: respond to a prospect saying *"I'm not interested, we already have someone doing that."*



Also tell us in your message:

- Which businesses you've worked (company + region)

- Your internet setup (wired or WiFi, speed, backup plan)



Applications without the audio recording will not be read. Applications that only include part 1 will not be read.



**What happens next**

Shortlisted candidates do a live call with us, then a paid trial on real dials before any ongoing arrangement.

title: Customer Engagement & Booking Specialist
description:
# Customer Booking & Appointment Setter



We are looking for a friendly, confident and reliable **Customer Booking & Appointment Setter** to join our team.



Your main role is to contact customer leads, follow up enquiries, answer basic questions and help turn suitable enquiries into confirmed bookings.



This is not a high-pressure sales role. We want someone who communicates naturally, follows up consistently and is comfortable asking for the booking.



## Main Responsibilities



* Call new and existing customer leads

* Follow up enquiries that have not yet booked

* Respond by phone, SMS and

* Answer basic questions about services and pricing

* Book and update appointments

* Keep accurate customer notes

* Make sure new enquiries are followed up promptly



## Working Arrangement



This role offers **flexible working hours**.



There will be a base amount of work each week for scheduled calls, follow-ups, messages and customer administration.



Outside those base hours, we are looking for someone who can remain reasonably flexible when new enquiries come in.



You will **not** be expected to sit at your computer all day. The idea is that you can manage your own day, while still checking for new enquiries and responding promptly where practical.



For example, if a new enquiry comes in, you may spend a short amount of time contacting the customer and updating the system, then continue with your day.



The role will use a **retainer plus hourly pay structure**.



We care more about **reliable follow-up and results than fixed office hours**.



## What We Are Looking For



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear and confident phone manner

* Friendly and professional communication

* Comfortable making outbound calls

* Strong follow-up habits

* Good organisation and attention to detail

* Reliable internet, computer and headset

* Quiet workspace suitable for customer calls

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow processes without sounding scripted



Previous experience in **customer service, appointment setting, reception, BPO, phone support or sales** is highly regarded.



## Individual Applicants Only



**We are not looking for an agency or outsourcing company.**



We want to hire **one individual who will be primarily dedicated to this position and our business**.



You may have other commitments, but this role should be one of your primary work commitments.



If you work through an agency, outsource your work to someone else, or actively manage many unrelated clients at the same time, please do not apply.



## Performance Expectations



Your main goal is to help turn genuine customer enquiries into confirmed bookings.



Performance will be based on a combination of:



* Confirmed bookings

* Booking conversion rate

* Follow-up consistency

* Customer communication quality

* Accuracy of bookings and notes

* Reliability and responsiveness



Booking expectations will take into account the number and quality of leads provided.



## How to Apply



Please send your application **as a message through OnlineJobs.ph**.



Do not send a generic cover letter.



Your message must start with:



**WATCHTOWER**



Then include:



1. Your name and location

2. Your previous phone/customer service experience

3. A link to a **1–2 minute voice recording**

4. Your available hours in **Perth, Western Australia time**

5. How flexible you can be outside your base hours

6. Your expected hourly rate

7. Whether you currently work for another employer or client, and approximately how many hours per week

8. Whether you work through an agency

9. Confirmation that you will personally complete all work for this role

10. Your internet connection and backup option



Also answer this in your message:



> A customer enquired a few days ago but has not booked. You call them and they say, “I’m interested, but I still need to think about it.”



**Write exactly what you would say next to the customer.**



For your voice recording, please:



* Introduce yourself

* Briefly explain your relevant experience

* Explain why you would suit this role

* Pretend you are calling a customer who recently enquired and you are trying to help them make a booking



**Applications without a voice recording or that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.**



We value **good communication, reliable follow-up, ownership and genuine customer service** over aggressive sales techniques.

AEPL has developed a prototype website that establishes the proposed visual direction, navigation structure and key user journeys. The organisation is not seeking a complete redesign at this stage; rather, the focus is on refining, implementing and future-proofing the approved prototype within WordPress.



AEPL intends to proceed with the redevelopment as a single project engagement, comprising:

Phase 1A – Refinement and Technical Architecture

Phase 1B – WordPress Development and Launch

Applicants are requested to provide separate pricing for each phase as well as a combined project price.

Key Requirements

- Review and refine the approved prototype for production implementation.

- Confirm responsive behaviour across desktop, tablet and mobile.

- Review accessibility, performance and security requirements.

- Define the WordPress architecture, including theme approach, plugin strategy, content structure and reusable components.

- Confirm the implementation plan and identify any required design adjustments.

- Implementation plan and assumptions.

title: Shopify & POD Manager Lister
description:
## About us

We're an established print-on-demand business that has already built and run multiple Etsy stores, handled our own production, and turned listing, designing, and fulfilling into a proven machine. Now we're taking the next step: moving onto Shopify and building that operation from the ground up.



This isn't a "fill a seat" role. You'll be our first Shopify-focused hire, and you'll help shape how the whole thing runs.



## The role

You'll own our Shopify listing and production workflow end to end. On day one, you'll roll up your sleeves and get listings out the door. As we grow, you'll help us build a small team of VAs and lead it.



## What you'll do

- List products on Shopify end to end: uploads, product data, pricing, variants, and descriptions.

- Manage production through TeeInBlue and Printbelle.

- Create and prep product graphics, mockups, and designs in Photoshop (and similar design tools).

- Own the TeeInBlue workflow — this is the heart of the role.

- Jump on voice calls when we need to talk things through. We move faster on a call.

- Keep every listing accurate, organized, and launch-ready.

- Set up listing processes and templates so we can scale and onboard VAs later.



## What you need

- Shopify experience (required).

- TeeInBlue experience (required — most important).

- Graphic design skills, including Photoshop (required).

- Printbelle experience (required).

- Comfortable getting on voice calls to review work and align on direction.

- Comfortable working independently and owning the full listing process.



## Big bonus

- You've played around with AI tools (ChatGPT, image generation, automation) and know how to use them to speed up real work.

- Experience managing or training VAs.

- Etsy or other marketplace experience.



## Details

- Manager role with a clear path to leading a team.

- Remote.

- Pay: $600/month, plus a launch bonus and quarterly bonuses.

- Raises: ~$25 every quarter.

title: AI Email Copywriter
description:
Hello there!



We are a growing
 Marketing Agency with 60+ active e-commerce clients looking for an enthusiastic and skilled AI
 Copywriter.



This is a part-time role where you will be working alongside our current team of 50+.



PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU CAN WRITE SMOOTH, CLEAR, HIGH-CONVERTING COPY USING CLAUDE AI AND KNOW HOW TO PROMPT IT CORRECTLY



We are looking for a top-tier
 copywriter first and foremost. Your main job is to write copy that reads smoothly, makes complete sense, and moves the reader toward a purchase without ever confusing them. This is not about generating words that sound nice. Every line needs to flow naturally, build logically on the line before it, and land with real clarity and persuasion.



We need someone who can use Claude AI to draft strong copy quickly, but who also knows how to take that output and polish it until it reads clean, human, and effortless. If a sentence feels clunky, repetitive, or like it was stitched together from random AI phrasing, you catch it and fix it before it ever reaches us.



This copy will be written for individual
 campaigns and flows across our client roster, primarily in health, supplements, beauty, and other higher-end DTC categories, including brands that speak to older, more discerning demographics. Brand references and context will be provided for every brief.



The final output for every
 must be clean, formatted copy — headline, subheader, body, and CTA — delivered in a structured format ready for the design team to build from.



As a secondary part of the role, you should know how to use Claude (and similar AI writing tools) to accelerate output, but strong prompting is only half the job. The other half is editorial: knowing how to rewrite, tighten, and smooth out AI output so it sounds like it was written by a skilled human copywriter, not generated.





Requirements:



- Minimum 1 year of
 copywriting experience, ideally in direct-response

- Highly proficient in Claude AI and skilled at prompting it to produce strong first drafts (this is the most important requirement)

- Strong editorial instinct: able to identify clunky, confusing, or "AI-sounding" copy and rewrite it until it flows naturally

- Experience writing direct-response copy for supplements, health, or other higher-end categories is a strong plus

- Comfortable writing for older or more sophisticated demographics who respond to clarity and trust over hype

- Proficient in English — copy must read naturally and never feel robotic or disjointed

- Proficient with Slack for team communication

- Able to work weekdays and weekends





Bonus Points:



- Direct experience writing for supplement or wellness brands

- Strong grasp of direct-response principles (hook writing, CTA hierarchy, urgency framing, social proof)

- Experience writing across multiple brands simultaneously without voice bleed

- A natural ear for rhythm and pacing in copy, knowing when a sentence needs to be cut, combined, or rewritten entirely





Your tasks as an AI
 Copywriter will include:



1. Use Claude AI to draft strong, on-brief
 copy based on the brand references and briefs we provide

2. Edit and refine every draft so the final copy reads smoothly, makes complete sense, and never confuses the reader

3. Match each brand's voice perfectly, with particular care for brands speaking to older or higher-end audiences

4. Write up to 30
s per day (the majority will typically be for one or two clients so the workflow stays efficient)

5. Deliver all final copy in a clean structured format: headline, subheader, body, CTA, and ender line

6. Communicate progress and revisions with the team in Slack

7. Complete all tasks daily before 3 PM PH time





We ask that you answer the questions below to help us get to know you.



Questions:



1. Have you written direct-response
 copy before, especially for supplements, health, or other higher-end categories? If yes, for how long, and do you have examples we can review?



2. Walk us through how you use Claude AI to draft copy. What does your prompting process look like, and how do you push it to get a strong first draft rather than something generic?



3. Once Claude gives you a draft, what do you look for when editing it? How do you know when a line "doesn't sound right" and needs to be rewritten?



4. Can you share a quick before-and-after example, AI's raw output versus your final edited version, so we can see how you improve it?



5. How do you write for an older or more sophisticated audience differently than you would for a younger, trend-driven one?



6. How do you keep your copy feeling fresh across multiple campaigns for the same brand without falling into repetitive angles or phrasing?





We are looking to grow very quickly over the next few months and this position will allow for opportunities to move into incentive-based pay and a salary increase. After 3 months, there will be a salary increase.



We ask that if you do provide examples, they be relevant to what the job describes.



Biweekly Pay: $150 CAD

Hours: 4 hours per day



Currently, you must be able to work at least 20hrs/week (including weekends)





*** HOW TO APPLY ***



*You must include your favorite color + AI tool in the subject line of your application for it to be considered (this shows you actually read it and is very important; if you do not have it in there, your application will be skipped).



1.) Send us a message answering all 6 questions

2.) Include examples of your
 copy work (formatted copy preferred, not screenshots)

3.) Include a before-and-after example showing raw AI output versus your final edited copy, if you have one



We look forward to hearing from you!

mbers.

s, offers, and customer journeys from a conversion perspective.

Experience with international e-commerce brands, UGC, ClickUp, Shopify apps, or AI-assisted marketing workflows would be an advantage.



WHY JOIN SMILEPRO

title: Outreach VA to Build Referral Partnerships for US Housing Provider
description:
About us

We are a veteran owned supportive housing provider in Southern California. We operate safe, furnished shared homes for veterans, seniors, and adults rebuilding their lives after hardship. We are small, we are growing, and we treat the people who work with us as part of the team.



About the role

Our goal is to build a network of referral partners: social workers, case managers, and housing navigators at county agencies, veteran organizations, shelters, and nonprofits. These are professionals whose job is to find housing for their clients. When they know us, they call us.



Your job is to find those people, introduce us, and get a 30 minute meeting on our calendar.



This is not sales. There is no product, no price, no pressure. You are letting someone who needs housing options know that safe beds are available. Most of them will be glad you called.



What you will do

Research and verify referral partner contacts across Riverside and San Bernardino Counties, finding the named person and direct
 rather than a general inbox. Send personalized introduction
s using templates we provide. Make friendly follow up calls to confirm the right. Book confirmed meetings and send reminders. Log every contact, call, and outcome in a shared tracker. Follow up on anything that goes quiet.



Requirements

Clear, warm, professional spoken English. You will be speaking with government employees and licensed social workers, so friendliness and clarity matter far more than speed.



Error free written English that does not read like a mass template.



At least one year in appointment setting, outbound calling, lead generation, or B2B outreach. Experience calling US organizations is strongly preferred.



Headset, computer (not phone only), quiet workspace, reliable internet, comfort with Google Sheets, Gmail, and Calendar.



Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement. You will handle professional contact information only, never resident information.



Schedule

US Pacific business hours, which is roughly 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time



How to apply

Subject line: Outreach VA + [your city] + VILLAGE



Answer in your own words: Can you realistically work overnight, and what is your sleep schedule now? Describe a time you called an organization and had to find the right person. Why would a social worker want to hear from a housing provider?

title: Product Reviewer – Simple Smartphone Videos of Products You Already Own
description:
We are looking for reliable people to create short, natural video reviews of products they already own and personally use.



This is NOT a traditional UGC advertising job.



We do NOT want highly produced commercials, flashy transitions, heavy effects, music, or complicated editing.



Think of it like this:



A friend asks you, “What do you think about that product?”



You pick up your phone, show them the product, and naturally explain your experience with it.



That is the style we want.



VIDEO STYLE:



* Approximately 30–60 seconds

* Smartphone video, minimum 1080p

* Clear spoken English

* Show the actual product

* Demonstrate how you use it when appropriate

* Explain useful features from your own experience

* Natural and conversational

* Basic cuts/simple editing only

* One continuous take is completely acceptable

* Clean and reasonably uncluttered filming area



DO NOT:



* Create a commercial

* Use flashy transitions or visual effects

* Add unnecessary music

* Make exaggerated product claims

* Read an obvious advertisement script

* Buy products specifically for this job



IMPORTANT:



You must ALREADY OWN and use the products you review.



Before you film anything for us, we will confirm the exact product with you.



Products generally need to have an exact matching listing on 
 in the United States.



You will never be asked to purchase a product just to complete a test.



PAID TEST:



Shortlisted applicants may be offered a $5 USD paid test video.



The test is paid whether or not we d
 to continue working together, as long as the requested test is completed according to the instructions.



This can become ongoing work for strong, reliable reviewers.



START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORD:



DESKLAMP



Then answer ALL of the following:



1. List at least 10 products you personally own and currently use.



Give the EXACT brand and model when possible.



Good example:

Logitech G502 HERO Gaming Mouse



Bad example:

Mouse



Prioritize electronics, kitchen items, home products, office products, tools, beauty/personal-care products, fitness products, pet products, automotive accessories, and other common consumer products.



If you can find the exact 
 U.S. link for the product, include it.



2. Send a link to a video of yourself speaking English naturally for at least 30 seconds.



This does NOT need to be professionally produced.



A simple smartphone selfie video is perfectly fine.



3. What smartphone will you use to record videos?



4. Describe where you would normally film.



For example: desk, bedroom, kitchen, living room, outdoor area, etc. Also tell us what lighting you have available.



5. In one or two sentences, explain the difference between an honest product review and an advertisement.



6. How many products do you estimate you currently own that could potentially be reviewed?



7. How many 30–60 second videos could you comfortably complete per week?



8. What is your preferred payment method?



You do NOT need professional camera equipment.



You do NOT need advanced video-editing skills.



You do NOT need previous UGC experience.



Natural spoken English, reliability, product ownership, and the ability to follow simple instructions are more important to us than professional video-production experience.

What You'll Be Doing Every Day

Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Ordering and tracking asset valuations and credit assessments

Requesting and tracking pricing and rate concessions from lenders

Running asset finance calculators — balloon payments, residual values, comparison rates, repayment schedules

Preparing compliance documents, credit diary notes, settlement letters, and payout figures

Ordering and interpreting commercial credit reports (e.g. Equifax, CreditorWatch, Veda)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention



You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements

Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have

Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer

Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

title: Senior Executive Assistant to Founder | Remote | Part-Time
description:
I’m looking for an exceptional, highly experienced Executive Assistant to work closely with me as the founder of Gaiama, a Singapore-based experiential culinary company creating chef-led dining experiences in extraordinary places around the world.



This is a long-term, part-time remote role for someone who is proactive, highly organised, fast, resourceful and exceptionally detail-oriented. You will support me primarily across Gaiama, alongside some personal and family administration, and occasionally support other team members on specific projects.



I am not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of tasks. I’m looking for an experienced EA who learns how I work, anticipates what needs to happen and takes ownership of getting it done.



My goal is eventually to be able to CC you on an
 and trust that you will identify the actions, ask only the questions you genuinely need answered, and close the loop without me having to manage the process.



What you’ll be responsible for



Your work will include:



* Managing calendar administration, scheduling meetings, creating video links and sending calendar invitations

* Researching flights, hotels and travel options, preparing itineraries and coordinating bookings

* Researching restaurants and making reservations internationally

* Managing expenses, receipts and expense reports

* Processing and tracking invoices and liaising with accountants/bookkeepers where required

* Making business and personal purchases and tracking deliveries

* Maintaining organised digital files and documentation

* Maintaining contact and CRM information

* Following up with suppliers, partners and other contacts and ensuring outstanding actions are closed

* Making international calls and communicating with suppliers, restaurants, hotels and other contacts

* Supporting personal and family administration, including appointments, travel, reservations, gifts, purchases and paperwork

* Learning and maintaining administrative systems including Procim

* Supporting other members of the Gaiama team with specific administrative tasks such as travel or ordering when required



The scope may evolve over time. For someone interested and capable, there is potential for the role to grow in hours and into broader project coordination or operations responsibilities as Gaiama grows.



Who I’m looking for



You should have:



* At least 7 years of relevant professional experience

* At least 3 years of proven experience as an Executive Assistant supporting a founder, entrepreneur, C-suite executive or similarly senior leader

* Proven success working remotely with international businesses or executives, ideally from the US, UK, Europe or Australia

* Exceptional spoken and written English

* Excellent judgement and the confidence to take initiative without waiting for detailed instructions

* Extremely high standards of organisation, accuracy and presentation

* Strong research skills and the ability to turn large amounts of information into clear recommendations

* The ability to manage multiple priorities, follow through and close loops

* A proactive, responsive, fast and resourceful working style

* Confidence communicating professionally with senior clients, suppliers and partners

* Strong digital skills and the ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly and independently

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT intelligently and responsibly to improve your work

* Your own Mac and a reliable high-speed internet connection

* A high level of discretion. You will have access to confidential business and personal information and will be required to sign an NDA.



A university degree is preferred.



Particularly valuable experience



Experience supporting a startup founder or entrepreneur is highly desirable.



Previous experience in event production, experiential marketing, hospitality, luxury, travel, a creative agency or another fast-moving project-based environment would be a significant advantage.



French or another additional language is a bonus, but not required.



Systems



Our current tools include Outlook, Apple Calendar, Google Workspace, Slack, WhatsApp, HubSpot, Dropbox, Excel/Google Sheets, Xero, Procim, Canva, Webflow, LinkedIn, ChatGPT, Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams.



You do not need experience with every system. I care much more about your ability to learn new technology quickly and independently.



Hours and working style



This is an ongoing part-time role of approximately 80 hours per month.



The hours are deliberately flexible rather than a fixed four-hour daily shift. Workload varies across the month and I travel internationally frequently, so some weeks will naturally be busier than others.



I need someone who maintains regular weekday availability, is generally reachable during Singapore business hours and can manage their workload independently. You may have other clients, but reliability and responsiveness are essential. During normal weekday working hours, I generally expect messages and new requests to be acknowledged within one hour, even if the task itself will be completed later.



There will occasionally be requirements outside normal Singapore/Philippines working hours due to international travel or events. These will be the exception rather than the norm, and working hours can flex accordingly.



Compensation



SGD 1,500–2,000 per month depending on experience, based on approximately 80 hours per month.



Exceptional candidates with particularly relevant senior EA, founder support and/or events or hospitality experience may be considered above this range.



This will be an independent contractor relationship, paid monthly.



For the right person, I am looking to build a long-term working relationship. The role has the potential to increase in hours, responsibility and scope as Gaiama grows.



Target start date is September/Q4 2026, but finding the right person is more important than starting quickly.



How to apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter.



Instead, introduce yourself briefly and answer the following five questions:



1. Tell me about the founder or senior executive you have supported most closely. How long did you work together, where were they based, what did you personally own for them, and what did you eventually learn to anticipate without being asked?

2. You are CC’d on an
 confirming that I will attend a three-day conference in Paris next month. I haven’t given you any instructions. What do you do?

3. Tell me about the most complicated international trip you have organised for someone else. What made it complicated and how did you manage it?

4. Which AI tools do you currently use in your work? Give me one specific example of how you have used AI to make your work better or faster while ensuring the final information was accurate.

5. Tell me about any experience you have in events, hospitality, luxury, travel, creative agencies or startup environments.



Please also include:



* Your CV/resume

* Your current availability and any existing client commitments

* Your current or most recent compensation/rate

* Your expected monthly rate for this role



Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer & Ads Launcher
description:
We are looking for a Meta Ads Media Buyer / Ads Launcher to join our team and take ownership of the day-to-day ad side of the business.



We are a 7-figure eCommerce company with a strong team, good morale, and high standards. We work fast, communicate well, and want someone who is respectful, easy to work with, and can genuinely take responsibility for their role without needing to be chased.



This is not just a role for someone who knows how to press publish in Ads Manager. We want someone who understands how to launch campaigns properly, monitor performance daily, test creatives and audiences, kill what is not working, and scale what is working without being reckless with spend.

You will work closely with our creative team to make sure ads are ready, uploaded, and launched on time. You will also be responsible for keeping the tracking sheet updated so the whole team can clearly see what is working, what is not, what we have learned, and what we should test next.



What you will be doing

You will be launching and managing Meta ad campaigns for an eCommerce brand, including campaign setup, ad sets, ads, naming conventions, budgets, targeting, and tracking checks before campaigns go live.

You will monitor performance every day and make decisions based on the data. This includes testing new creatives, hooks, angles, copy, offers, and audiences; switching off ads that are not performing; and scaling winning ads while keeping a close eye on ROAS, CPA, cost per purchase, and overall profitability.

You will make sure the account is organised and launch-ready. That includes checking Pixels or datasets, conversion events, UTMs, tracking, access, billing, and any other issues that could stop a campaign from launching or tracking properly.

You will also keep our tracking sheet up to date with spend, results, test outcomes, and learnings. We want someone who can clearly tell the team what is happening in the account, what needs more creative support, and what should be tested next.



What we are looking for

You should have real hands-on experience managing and launching Meta Ads for eCommerce brands. We are looking for someone who understands both the performance side and the operations side of paid ads.

You should be confident with campaign setup, ABO and CBO testing, audience research, creative testing, budget management, optimisation, retargeting, reporting, and scaling. You should also understand Meta Pixel or Dataset setup, conversion events, basic Conversion API support, and how to identify and solve basic tracking or launch issues.

Experience using tools such as Meta Ads Manager, Triple Whale, Google Sheets, Notion, ClickUp, Slack, and other attribution or reporting tools is a big plus.

Most importantly, we want someone who is organised, proactive, and reliable. You should be comfortable working with a creative team, communicating clearly, taking ownership of deadlines, and treating the ad budget with care.



To apply

Please send us a short introduction, your experience managing Meta Ads for eCommerce brands, the highest monthly ad spend you have managed, the tools you are comfortable using, and a few examples of results you have achieved. Please also include details of how you approach testing, killing losing ads, and scaling winning campaigns.

title: Hospitality / Airbnb Operations Specialist
description:
STR & Hotel Operations Manager



Airbnb | Vrbo | 
 | Expedia | Mews | SiteMinder | Breezeway | PriceLabs



We operate a 39-suite hospitality property that combines the **short-term rental model with traditional hotel operations.**



We are looking for someone with strong experience managing:



* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* 

* Expedia

* OTA listings and distribution

* Short-term rental operations

* Hotel operations

* Dynamic pricing

* Property management systems

* Channel managers

* Property operations software



**This is NOT a basic Virtual Assistant position.**



We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to answering Airbnb messages, customer service, data entry, or basic administrative work.



We need someone who understands **Airbnb/Vrbo AND hotel/OTA operations** and is technically comfortable enough to understand how all of the systems behind them work together.



OUR TECHNOLOGY STACK



Our operation currently uses:



* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* 

* Expedia

* Mews PMS

* SiteMinder

* Breezeway

* PriceLabs

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets



Experience with several of these systems is strongly preferred.



You do NOT necessarily need experience with every single platform.



However, you MUST have enough real hospitality and short-term rental experience to understand how OTAs, PMS systems, channel managers, pricing systems, reservations, inventory and property operations connect.



 OUR BUSINESS MODEL



Our property is unusual because it combines two hospitality models.



We operate with the infrastructure and systems of a hotel, while our inventory primarily consists of large multi-bedroom suites designed for groups.



We therefore need someone who understands both:



**Airbnb / Vrbo / Short-Term Rentals**



AND



**Hotels / 
 / Expedia / OTA Distribution**



We need someone capable of helping us blend these two worlds into one efficient operation.



AIRBNB, VRBO & OTA MANAGEMENT



You will eventually help take ownership of:



* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* 

* Expedia

* Additional OTAs as we expand



Responsibilities include:



* Creating new listings

* Writing listing titles and descriptions

* Updating existing listings

* Managing photos and listing content

* Updating amenities

* Updating policies

* Managing room and property information

* Checking bedroom/bathroom counts

* Monitoring listing accuracy

* Monitoring availability

* Monitoring rates

* Monitoring minimum stays

* Managing promotions and discounts

* Identifying duplicate listings

* Troubleshooting OTA problems

* Communicating with OTA support

* Monitoring reservation delivery

* Identifying incorrect pricing or availability



You should be comfortable navigating Airbnb, Vrbo, 
 and Expedia without needing the owner to show you where everything is.



LISTING CONTENT



You must be capable of creating professional hospitality listing content.



This includes:



* Airbnb titles

* Airbnb descriptions

* Vrbo descriptions

* 
 content

* Expedia content

* Room descriptions

* Property descriptions

* Amenity descriptions

* House rules

* Guest instructions

* Check-in information



Your written English must be excellent.



We do not want descriptions that sound robotic, generic, poorly translated, or obviously AI-generated.



PMS & CHANNEL MANAGEMENT



Our property uses:



**Mews — PMS**



**SiteMinder — Channel Manager**



You will help manage and troubleshoot:



* Room and space categories

* Rate plans

* Inventory

* Availability

* Restrictions

* Minimum stays

* Reservation delivery

* Channel mappings

* Room mappings

* Rate mappings

* OTA connectivity

* Synchronization problems



You should understand the basic flow of information between:



**Property ? PMS ? Channel Manager ? OTA**



and understand that manually changing something in one system can sometimes be overwritten by another system.



PRICING & REVENUE SYSTEMS



We use PriceLabs for dynamic pricing.



You should understand or be capable of quickly learning:



* Dynamic pricing

* Base rates

* Minimum rates

* Minimum stays

* Event pricing

* Last-minute pricing

* OTA markups

* Promotions

* Length-of-stay discounts

* Channel-specific pricing

* Rate discrepancies



You do not need to be a professional Revenue Manager.



You DO need to recognize when pricing doesn't make sense and know how to investigate why.



BREEZEWAY & PROPERTY OPERATIONS



Breezeway is an important part of our operation.



You will help manage:



* Inspections

* Maintenance tasks

* Cleaning tasks

* Guest-reported issues

* Task assignments

* Due dates

* Open tasks

* Overdue tasks

* Completed tasks

* Staff follow-up

* Property readiness



This job is NOT simply creating tasks.



You need to make sure tasks actually get completed.



If maintenance marks something FINISHED but an inspection shows that the problem still exists, the problem is not finished.



You will be expected to follow up with staff and keep open items visible until they are genuinely resolved.



The owner should NOT have to open Breezeway every night to discover what employees failed to complete.



GOOGLE DRIVE & GOOGLE SHEETS



You must be comfortable using:



* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Google Docs

* Shared folders

* File organization

* Filters and sorting

* Basic formulas

* Operational trackers

* Reports



You may receive messy information from several different systems and be expected to organize it into something useful.



THE PERSON WE WANT



We want someone who can receive a message like:



**"
 says sold out, Airbnb has availability, Expedia has the wrong price, a reservation didn't reach Mews, and Breezeway has overdue maintenance tasks."**



And respond:



**"I'm looking into it."**



Then actually figure it out.



You should be able to determine:



* What system is causing the problem

* Where the information originated

* Who needs to be contacted

* What should be changed

* What should NOT be changed

* Whether the problem was actually fixed

* How to prevent it from happening again



We want someone who is:



* Extremely proactive

* Analytical

* Detail-oriented

* Technically comfortable

* Organized

* Persistent

* Independent

* Excellent in English

* Good at troubleshooting

* Comfortable holding staff accountable

* Comfortable communicating with support departments

* Able to learn unfamiliar software quickly



We DO NOT want someone who waits all day for the owner to give them individual tasks.



If you see something wrong, investigate it.



If someone hasn't completed a task, follow up.



If a reservation didn't synchronize, investigate it.



If pricing looks wrong, investigate it.



If a listing contains incorrect information, fix it.



If you cannot solve something, escalate it with a clear explanation of what you already investigated.



**Our goal is for this person to eventually understand our online hospitality operation well enough that ownership does not need to constantly monitor it.**



!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!               REQUIRED APPLICATION TEST BELOW               !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!



Generic applications will not be considered.



Do not simply tell us you are hardworking, organized, proactive, detail-oriented or a fast learner.



**We want to see how you actually think.**



SCENARIO



You manage online operations for a 39-suite hospitality property.



The property sells through:



**Airbnb**



**Vrbo**



**
**



**Expedia**



The property also uses:



**Mews — PMS**



**SiteMinder — Channel Manager**



**PriceLabs — Dynamic Pricing**



**Breezeway — Inspections, Maintenance & Operational Tasks**



You log in one morning and discover:



* Mews shows 5 suites available for a particular date.

* Airbnb shows 5 available.

* 
 shows SOLD OUT.

* Expedia shows availability, but the price is $200 lower than Airbnb.

* PriceLabs appears to show the correct price.

* A 
 reservation received yesterday appears in SiteMinder but is missing from Mews.

* Breezeway shows 12 overdue maintenance tasks.

* Three tasks are marked completed by maintenance, but the most recent inspection shows the same problems still exist.

* One Airbnb listing has an incorrect bedroom count.

* The owner tells you a new room type was created last week and may not have been added everywhere.



You are the only OTA/operations manager working that morning.



QUESTIONS

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.

Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!

Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)
