title: SaaS Operations & Automation Specialist — Data Quality & Client Delivery
description:
FULL-TIME | LONG-TERM | REMOTE | APPROXIMATELY 40 HOURS PER WEEK | U.S. CENTRAL TIME OVERLAP



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are building a new technology-enabled data-intelligence and operational-review service for businesses in the United States.



Our work involves reviewing information from multiple business systems, identifying conflicts and missing actions, verifying evidence, and producing clear reports showing clients what deserves attention.



We are looking for our first full-time operations and automation specialist. This person will help shape the service from its early stages and may grow into a central operational and client-facing role.



This is not a basic virtual-assistant position. It is also not a traditional software-development position.



The right person will combine:



* Investigative and analytical judgment

* Excellent attention to detail

* Comfort working with messy or conflicting information

* Automation and technical ability

* Clear written and spoken English

* Reliable follow-through

* The ability to eventually communicate confidently with U.S. clients



Industry experience is not required. We can teach the industry. We are looking for someone who is naturally careful, curious, honest, dependable, and capable of working through unfamiliar problems.



Because this is an early-stage project, specific industry details, workflows, and client applications will be shared with serious finalists rather than disclosed publicly.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Review information from Excel, CSV files, Google Sheets, PDFs, database exports, calendars, photographs, and other business records.

* Compare multiple sources and identify inconsistencies, missing information, unusual records, and unfinished operational actions.

* Investigate findings carefully instead of assuming the first result is correct.

* Separate verified findings from possibilities requiring additional evidence.

* Assign appropriate confidence levels and preserve the evidence supporting each finding.

* Help create repeatable workflows for reviewing each client’s information.

* Build and improve automations using tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, APIs, scripts, or similar systems.

* Create clean client reports, exception lists, trackers, and internal documentation.

* Perform quality control before findings are presented to clients.

* Explain technical or data-related findings in simple language.

* Join selected U.S. client calls after training.

* Track open questions, blockers, next actions, and deadlines.

* Help turn an early-stage service into a dependable and scalable operation.

* Handle confidential company and client information responsibly.



You will never be expected to present an uncertain result as a verified fact. If the evidence is incomplete, we expect you to say so and explain what should be checked next.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Excellent written English

* Strong enough spoken English for future U.S. client conversations

* Advanced comfort with Excel or Google Sheets

* Experience reviewing, cleaning, reconciling, or analyzing messy data

* Experience with automation, integrations, databases, APIs, or technical workflows

* Strong research and problem-solving ability

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Ability to document work clearly

* Ability to work independently without guessing when instructions or evidence are incomplete

* Willingness to ask thoughtful questions and identify risks

* Ability to handle confidential information appropriately

* Dependable internet connection and a reliable computer

* Availability for approximately 40 hours per week

* Availability for meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time and scheduled client calls

* Interest in a serious, long-term position



We care more about demonstrated ability, judgment, and reliability than degrees or job titles.



HELPFUL BUT NOT REQUIRED



* Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, Airtable, SQL, Python, APIs, or similar tools

* SaaS operations or implementation experience

* Data-quality, quality-assurance, audit, research, or business-analysis experience

* Experience creating client-facing reports

* Experience speaking directly with U.S. business owners

* Experience helping build a new process, product, or service from an early stage



THIS ROLE MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU



* Enjoy solving problems that do not have perfectly clean instructions.

* Want to understand why information conflicts instead of merely correcting a spreadsheet.

* Notice small details that other people overlook.

* Can distinguish between a verified fact, a reasonable possibility, and an unsupported assumption.

* Are comfortable saying, “I do not know yet, but here is how I would find out.”

* Like building processes that become more accurate and efficient over time.

* Can communicate with both technical and nontechnical people.

* Want responsibility and growth rather than repetitive task work.



DO NOT APPLY IF YOU



* Only want to write code and do not enjoy investigation, documentation, or communication.

* Need every step explained before you can make progress.

* Frequently guess when information is missing.

* Are uncomfortable having your work carefully reviewed.

* Are looking for a short-term position or a second full-time job.

* Cannot reliably provide meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time.

* Are unwilling to follow reasonable confidentiality and data-handling requirements.



SCHEDULE

Accounts Receivable & Admin Specialist | Part-Time, 20 Hours Per Week | Remote (Philippines) | Australian Business Hours



Most accounts receivable roles keep you at arm's length from the work that matters. You reconcile, you allocate, you send the statement — and when an account goes 60 days overdue, someone else makes the call. Your judgment on which clients to push and which to protect never leaves your own notes.

This role is built the other way around.



About the Company

Go Ignite is partnering with an established Australian IT managed services company supporting small and medium businesses across a range of industries. They are known for clear communication and honest advice — the same standard they apply to how they handle their own client accounts.



About the Role

You will take ownership of the accounts receivable ledger in Xero, working alongside the company's local bookkeeper. This is a client-facing position: you will contact Australian business owners and their accounts teams directly by phone and
 to follow up on outstanding invoices, resolve billing disputes, and secure payment commitments. Where accounts remain unresolved, you will escalate and coordinate suspensions in line with company policy.



This is the company's first offshore hire in this function. You will be establishing how the process runs, not inheriting someone else's version of it. Broader administrative support sits alongside the AR work as the business requires.



Responsibilities:

Monitor the accounts receivable ledger in Xero and identify overdue or at-risk accounts

Contact clients by phone and
 to follow up on outstanding invoices and secure payment

Escalate unresolved accounts and coordinate suspensions in line with company policy

Process and allocate incoming payments, reconcile AR records, and flag discrepancies to the local bookkeeper

Act as a professional point of contact for billing queries, liaising with clients' accounts teams to resolve disputes

Report to management on outstanding accounts and drive down average days outstanding

Provide administrative support across quotes, vendor invoices, licence and contract renewals, scheduling, and reporting



What You'll Bring:

With 3 years in accounts receivable, collections, or a comparable finance and administration role

Hands-on Xero experience across invoicing, payment allocation, and reconciliation

Excellent spoken and written English, with genuine confidence making outbound collection calls

A proven ability to handle sensitive payment conversations assertively while protecting the client relationship

Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping

Experience providing administrative support in a fast-paced business

Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup

Availability across Australian business hours



Why This Opportunity Is Different:

Collections is a skill that is easy to undervalue and difficult to replace. In this role it is visible: management will see the ledger move, and the difference will be attributable to how you work an account. As the first person in this function, the process you establish becomes the standard the business runs on — and the professional credibility that comes with that is not something a processing role can offer.



Compensation & Benefits:

Starting offer at Php25,000, based on experience 

20 hours per week, aligned to Australian business hours

Fully remote, Philippines-based

Paid time off

Prepaid HMO



How to Apply

Submit your CV and answer the following:

1. How many years' experience do you have in an Accounts Receivable Role?

2. What's your proficiency level with Xero Software (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced)?

3. Are you comfortable making outbound phone calls to follow up on overdue invoices, request payment, and professionally but firmly escalate accounts when payment is not received?

title: Product Photo Retoucher — Add Brand Logo to Activewear Photos
description:
We are Isla Active, a new premium women's activewear brand based in Koh Samui, Thailand. We're anchored to a reformer pilates studio and launching on TikTok Shop Thailand, Shopee and Lazada.



We have just received our first production run — 1,800 pieces of leggings, sports bras, shorts and t-shirts. We have professional product photography from our manufacturer, but the garments in those photos are unbranded. We need our logo added to them so the images match what we actually ship.



This is real, ongoing work for a growing brand, not a one-off gig.



The job



You will take our existing professional product photos and:



Composite our logo onto the garments so it looks genuinely printed or heat-pressed into the fabric — following the fabric's stretch, folds, curve and lighting. Not pasted flat on top.

Clean up backgrounds — replace with pure white or neutral studio grey, consistent across the whole catalogue.

Colour-match and standardise — our 4 colourways (Black, Cacao Brown, Light Blue, Pink) must look accurate and consistent across every image and every product.

Export to marketplace specs — 1:1 square, 1000×1000px minimum, JPEG under 5MB, correctly named per our convention.



Expected volume: roughly 150–250 images in the first month, then ongoing as we add products.



Skills you must have

Adobe Photoshop (required — no alternatives)

Displacement mapping — you must know how to make a logo conform to fabric texture and stretch. If you don't know what a displacement map is, this role is not for you.

Blend modes (Multiply, Soft Light, Overlay) and how to match a logo's lighting and shadow to the underlying photo

Clean pen-tool / precision masking around hair, fingers and fabric edges

Colour correction and matching across a batch

Batch processing with Actions to keep output consistent

Working English — enough to understand written feedback and ask questions when a brief is unclear



Nice to have: experience with apparel or activewear e-commerce; familiarity with TikTok Shop, Shopee or Lazada listing requirements; basic short-form video editing (we may add this later at a higher rate).



Important: what this job is NOT



Please read this carefully — it's the most common misunderstanding.



We do NOT want AI-generated images. No AI-generated models. No AI-generated lifestyle scenes, beaches, gyms or fabricated environments. No generative re-rendering of the garment itself.



Marketplace policies now require visible "AI-generated" disclosure labels on synthetic product imagery, and we will not risk our listings.



You may use AI-assisted tools for cutout, masking, background removal and cleanup — that is normal post-production and it's fine. But the product must remain pixel-for-pixel the real product. We retouch. We do not generate.



Applications built around Midjourney, Sora or similar generative portfolios will not be considered.



Accuracy matters more than beauty



Our physical garments have the logo in one specific location at one specific size. Your job is to replicate exactly that — not to make the nicest-looking composition.



If a customer receives a product that doesn't match the photo, we get returns and our seller rating drops. We will give you reference photos of the actual physical garment. Match them precisely. If something in the brief looks wrong or inconsistent, tell us before you edit 50 images.



Pay, hours and how we'll work

$5.00 – $7.00 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated skill

Tracked through OnlineJobs.ph TimeProof

Paid weekly

First week capped at 10 hours so we can both assess fit, then we'll increase



On throughput: we understand the first few images are slow while you build the logo template, displacement map and Photoshop Action. After that we'd expect roughly 6–12 finished images per hour. We're not going to micromanage you — but please flag it early if the work is running significantly slower than that so we can adjust the brief instead of burning hours.



We will provide: logo in vector (.AI, .SVG, .EPS) and transparent PNG, a written placement spec in centimetres, reference photos of the real garment, and the full source image library in Google Drive.



How to apply



Applications that don't follow this format will be ignored. Please send:



The word "CACAO" at the top of your message, so we know you read the full post.

2–3 before/after examples of logo or graphic compositing onto fabric or clothing. This is the single most important part of your application — portfolios without apparel compositing work will not be shortlisted.

A short answer to this question: How would you make a logo follow the curve and stretch of the waistband on a pair of leggings? Two or three sentences is enough — we just want to know you understand the technique.

Your hourly rate and how many hours per week you can commit.

Your Photoshop version and confirmation you have a stable internet connection for transferring large files.



Paid test task: shortlisted applicants will be given 2 images to edit for a fixed $5 USD, paid whether or not we hire you. Expect roughly 30–60 minutes of work. We'll hire from that test.



We reply to every shortlisted applicant within 3 days.

title: Appointment Setter — US Marketing Agency (HVAC Cold Calling, Long-Term)
description:
NeuroBoost Media is a Meta ads agency serving home-service businesses (HVAC, roofing, painting) across the United States. We're a small, growing team hiring dedicated appointment setters to become a core part of what we're building. This is not a temporary gig — we want people who will grow with us long-term.



SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Pacific Time (roughly 12 AM to 8 AM Philippines time). Graveyard shift — you must be able to commit to this schedule long-term.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- 100 to 150 outbound calls per day to HVAC business owners in the United States

- Follow our proven script and playbook (full training provided)

- Book qualified discovery meetings on our founder's calendar

- Log every call in our custom-built dialer tool

- Get real-time AI coaching during every call — our custom tool shows you exact lines to say, objection responses, and warnings if you're going off-script. You will never be alone on a call.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Near-native American English pronunciation — this is non-negotiable, HVAC business owners in the US need to hear an accent they trust

- Minimum 6 months of prior outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

- Stable high-speed internet, quiet home office, reliable computer, and quality headset

- Thick skin — you can handle rejection and push through 100+ dials a day without losing energy

- Someone who wants long-term stability, not a stopgap job between other work



COMPENSATION



We don't pay for showing up — we pay for work done. Here's the structure:



- Week 1 (Trial Week): $200 USD, released only after you complete 300 dials during your first week. If you don't hit 300 dials, you don't get paid for that week. This is intentional — it filters out non-serious applicants and ensures we're both committed before we invest further in each other.

- Base (Week 2 onward): $1,000 USD per month, paid weekly, contingent on maintaining a minimum of 100 dials per working day.

- Meeting Bonus: $30 USD for every qualified meeting you book.

- Retainer Sign Bonus: $300 USD for every client that signs a retainer from meetings you booked.

- Realistic top performers earn $1,800 to $2,500 USD per month total.



A qualified meeting is defined as one where the prospect (a) attends the scheduled call, (b) is the owner or decision-maker, and (c) operates an HVAC business with at least 2 trucks. Meeting bonuses are paid weekly for meetings that meet all three criteria.



TRAINING AND SUPPORT



- Script and playbook training on Day 1 before you start dialing (unpaid — this is your investment in the role, same as we invest in you)

- Access to recorded example calls

- Direct daily support from the founder

- Team Slack channel with other appointment setters

- Real-time AI coaching tool active on every call you make



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without answers to all 3 questions below will be ignored:



1. How many months of outbound cold-calling experience do you have, and in what industry or industries?



2. What are you currently doing during 12 AM to 8 AM Philippines time, and how will you commit to this graveyard schedule long-term?



3. Record a 60-second voice sample introducing yourself as if you were opening a cold call to a US HVAC business owner. Attach the audio file to your application, or upload it to a public hosting site like SoundCloud or YouTube and include the link in your application.



We respond to serious candidates within 48 hours.

title: Solar Permitting Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

NRG Clean Power is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Solar Permitting Coordinator to join our growing team. In this role, you will act as the crucial link between our design team, project managers, local municipalities (AHJs), and utility companies. You will be responsible for preparing, submitting, and tracking all necessary permit applications to ensure our solar projects are approved accurately and efficiently. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with excellent communication skills and a strong ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



Key Responsibilities

Permit Preparation: Assemble and review permit application packages, including structural and electrical engineering designs, site plans, and required jurisdictional forms.



Submission & Tracking: Submit permit applications to local Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and Homeowners Associations (HOAs) via online portals, mail, or in-person delivery (expediting).



Interconnection Applications: Prepare and submit utility interconnection applications and track them through to the Final Permission to Operate (PTO) stage.



Relationship Management: Build and maintain positive working relationships with city planners, building departments, and utility representatives to facilitate smooth approvals.



Issue Resolution: Promptly address and resolve any permit rejections, plan check corrections, or requests for additional information by coordinating directly with internal design and engineering teams.



Data Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all permitting activities, milestones, and expenses within the company CRM Salesforce.



Reporting: Provide regular updates to project managers and sales teams regarding pipeline status and expected approval timelines.



Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: Minimum [1-2] years of experience in permitting, project coordination, or administrative roles within the solar, construction, or roofing industries.



Language Skills: Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively advocate for the company with local government officials and utility representatives.



Application & Tech Proficiency: Highly adept at learning and navigating various software applications, including online municipal permitting portals, utility interconnection platforms, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.



Knowledge: Familiarity with local building codes, zoning laws, and AHJ requirements is highly preferred. Basic understanding of solar PV systems is a strong plus.



Attention to Detail: Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to manage complex paperwork and catch errors before submission.

description:
Job Title: SOP & Process Documentation Specialist 

Employment Type: Part-Time (40 hours/week)

Department: Operations & Systems Infrastructure



About the Role

We are seeking a sharp, highly methodical FULL-Time SOP & Process Documentation Specialist to take full ownership of our internal knowledge architecture and operational playbooks.



Our company operates on an active Waybook workspace. We have clear operational departments—including Dispatch & Route Optimization, Motor Pool & Fleet Inspections, Driver Onboarding & Compliance, and Administrative Workflows—and we need a systemization professional to bridge raw field execution with structured, scalable documentation.



You will not just be writing text; you will be mapping processes, interviewing department leads, establishing testing/quiz completion gates, and building a single source of operational truth.



Key Responsibilities

Waybook Workspace Management: Architect, organize, and maintain our active Waybook platform—structuring Subjects, Categories, Modules, and Documents into a logical, easily navigable hierarchy.



Process Mapping & Workflow Capture: Interview key department heads (Lead Dispatcher, Mechanic, Fleet Coordinators, Compliance Leads) to extract daily operational workflows and convert them into clear, step-by-step SOPs.



Content Creation & Visual Clarity: Write precise, clear, and unambiguous standard operating procedures. Incorporate visual aids, decision trees, workflow diagrams, and screenshots to ensure maximum readability for field personnel and office staff.



Accountability & Training Paths: Build trackable onboarding paths, knowledge-check quizzes, and completion gates inside Waybook to ensure staff and drivers are tested and held accountable to operational standards.



Process Auditing & Continuous Improvement: Regularly review and update documentation as tools, software (Fleetio, CRM systems, dispatch software), and state regulatory requirements evolve. Eliminate duplicate, outdated, or conflicting guidelines.



Terminology & Asset Consistency: Enforce standardized terminology and documentation conventions across all company assets, policies, and operational manuals.



Qualifications & Requirements

Proven Experience in SOP/Process Documentation: 3+ years writing, organizing, and auditing operational manuals, standard operating procedures, and training frameworks.



Platform Proficiency: Direct hands-on experience using Waybook (or comparable systems like Trainual, SweetProcess, Notion, or Process Street).



Information Architecture Skills: Ability to organize complex, multi-departmental information so that end-users (from drivers to managers) can find answers in seconds.



Interview & Extraction Skills: Exceptional interpersonal skills to extract raw, unorganized knowledge from busy subject-matter experts and translate it into structured procedures.



High Detail Orientation & Compliance Mindset: Meticulous approach to grammar, formatting, step ordering, and logical consistency.



Experience in Transportation, Logistics, or Fleet Operations is a strong plus, though not required.



Position Details & Schedule

Location: 100% Remote.

Briefly tell us about your background in process documentation, your experience with tools like Waybook, and why you thrive in creating structured systems. (Applications without a video introduction will not be reviewed.)

title: Admin & Receptionist (Remote - Australian NDIS Provider)
description:
VIRTUAL ASSISTANT / REMOTE RECEPTIONIST



The Positive Behaviour Support Group (PBSG) is an Australian NDIS provider seeking an exceptional part-time to become full-time Virtual Assistant / Remote Receptionist to support administrative operations, client communication, and business growth.



This is a long-term position.







ROLE OVERVIEW



This is a highly structured, process-driven role requiring exceptional professionalism, attention to detail, strong communication skills, and outstanding technological proficiency.



You will work inside a purpose-built system: step-by-step SOPs with annotated screenshots, in-app
 templates that auto-fill and send with a few clicks, custom dashboards that track every task, and automated reminders that catch follow-ups. The tools do a lot of the heavy lifting. What we need from you is speed, accuracy, and the ability to move confidently through software.







IMPORTANT:



– This is a role where reliability, responsiveness, and availability during working hours are essential.

– While workload will continue to grow over time, you must be consistently available to manage enquiries, respond promptly, and support incoming communication.

– You must be highly comfortable with technology and able to learn new software quickly. We use numerous systems (Microsoft 365, a practice management system (Splose), and several custom-built internal tools for phone calls, SMS messaging and administrative tracking) and expect team members to confidently navigate between multiple applications while working efficiently and accurately.

– Speed matters. We are looking for someone who works quickly without compromising accuracy, follows processes efficiently, and continually improves their productivity. Our systems are designed to be easy to follow. We need someone who moves through them fluently, not someone who gets stuck on unfamiliar screens.

– Independent problem-solving matters. While you will receive substantial training and support, when something unfamiliar comes up, we expect you to first check the SOP, search the system, use Google or AI tools, and think it through, then escalate with a clear summary and your suggested solution when a decision is genuinely needed.







RESPONSIBILITIES



– Manage incoming enquiries via
 and online channels

– Respond to new client enquiries and guide stakeholders through the referral process

– Gather key intake information accurately and efficiently

– Maintain clear, calm, and professional communication at all times

– Record notes and update systems

– Assist with scheduling, follow-ups, and general administrative coordination

– Support onboarding and intake processes for new participants

– Maintain and update internal tracking systems, including participant and employee trackers

– Monitor key workflows to ensure tasks are completed and follow-ups are not missed

– Assist with setting up new participants, contacts, and relevant information in internal systems

– Support employee onboarding and administration, including documentation and system setup

– Assist with organising, filtering, and coordinating job applications and interviews

– Help manage recruitment processes, including shortlisting candidates and scheduling interviews

– Perform general administrative tasks to support daily business operations and growth

– Adapt quickly to new systems, software, tools, and responsibilities as the business continues to expand

– Be available during working hours to answer incoming calls through our browser-based phone system

– Return missed calls promptly and professionally

– Follow structured call scripts and communication standards

– Escalate complex or sensitive matters appropriately — with context, what you've already checked, and your suggested next step









REQUIREMENTS



COMMUNICATION



– Excellent written and spoken English (exceptional communication is essential as you will be customer-facing )

– Professional, warm, calm, and confident communication style

– Strong attention to detail

– Ability to handle sensitive conversations professionally



TECHNOLOGY & PRODUCTIVITY



– Excellent computer skills and strong technological proficiency

– Able to quickly learn new software, systems, and workflows

– Fast and efficient when working across multiple systems

– Highly proficient with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Office, and Outlook

– Comfortable learning and using practice management systems and custom dashboards

– Confident navigating multiple applications simultaneously

– Strong typing skills and efficient computer navigation

– Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT) and Google to solve problems independently



WORK ENVIRONMENT



You must have:



– A modern laptop (Windows preferred)

– A high-quality noise-cancelling headset

– A backup power solution (UPS, generator, or equivalent) to prevent downtime during unexpected power outages

– A stable, reliable high-speed internet connection with back-up power

– A professional, organised work-from-home setup with minimal background noise and distractions



The above requirements are essential. If you do not have the above, please avoid applying as we would like to progress only with candidates who we can consider for the position.



EXPERIENCE



Previous experience in administration, customer service, reception, healthcare, or a similar role is highly regarded. Demonstrated speed and fluency with technology is weighted more heavily than years of experience. NDIS experience in highly desirable.







IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are someone who:



– Loves technology and enjoys learning new software

– Works quickly while maintaining excellent attention to detail

– Is highly organised and process-oriented

– Follows systems and SOPs consistently

– Tries to solve problems yourself first, then asks well-structured questions rather than making assumptions

– Communicates professionally without being overly casual

– Builds rapport while maintaining professional boundaries

– Is dependable, responsive, and highly reliable

– Wants a long-term career rather than a short-term job







OUR HIRING PROCESS



We want to be upfront about the process so you know what to expect. There are three stages:



1. First interview - a video call to get to know you, your experience, and your communication style.

2. Second interview - a deeper conversation about the role, our systems, and how you approach problem-solving and unfamiliar situations.

3. Paid practical trial - a short, paid working session (a few hours) in a safe training version of our real systems. You'll follow our actual SOPs to complete realistic tasks - for example, setting up a participant from a referral, sending a templated
, and handling a scenario the SOP doesn't fully cover. Your work is graded on accuracy, speed, and how you handle the unfamiliar. This is a two-way trial: you get to see exactly what the job is like before committing, and we get to see how you work. You are paid for this time regardless of the outcome.



Successful candidates receive a formal offer after the trial.







APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



To apply, please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A short video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself.



Please submit only via onlinejobs.ph messaging. As there anticipate a high volume of enquiries for this position, direct
s will be ignored and blacklisted. Our inbox has a high volume of important
s for our NDIS participants and employees; we do not want to add to our customer response time by receiving applications there. Thank you for understanding.



IN YOUR VIDEO, PLEASE TELL US:



– Who you are

– Your previous experience

– Why you are interested in joining PBSG

– Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role

– Your experience with technology and learning new software. Including a specific example of a time you figured out an unfamiliar system or tool on your own



This video is a mandatory part of the application process and helps us assess your communication skills, professionalism, confidence, and English fluency.







ADDITIONAL INFORMATION



Please only apply if you are extremely confident in your communication skills, technological ability, and capacity to meet a high professional standard. We will be undergoing a thorough and comprehensive interviewing and trial process.



We are hiring for a long-term position and will be carefully screening applications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



We provide comprehensive step-by-step SOPs with screenshots, structured systems, ongoing training, regular check-ins, and continuous support. Our goal is to develop a strong long-term working relationship with someone who can become a trusted and valued member of our organisation as we continue to grow.







PAY & BENEFITS



– USD $8.00 per hour, plus a 13th-month bonus (pro rata), paid via Wise weekly

– 2 weeks paid personal leave per year (pro rata)

– 5 paid sick days per year (pro rata)

– The practical trial stage is paid at the usual rate.

title: Tiktok UGC Video Creator
description:
TikTok Shop UGC Video Creator & Brand Partnerships Specialist



We are looking for a creative, resourceful, and results-driven TikTok Shop UGC Video Creator to identify profitable product opportunities, produce engaging short-form videos, and develop relationships with brands. This role combines content creation, affiliate marketing, product research, trend analysis, and brand outreach.



The ideal candidate understands what makes TikTok content feel authentic and compelling, can quickly identify products with strong sales potential, and is comfortable reaching out to brands to negotiate collaborations and paid partnerships.



Key Responsibilities



Product and Promotion Research



Research TikTok Shop to identify trending, high-converting, and underserved products.

Find attractive affiliate opportunities, including products offering competitive commission rates, limited-time commission boosts, free samples, coupons, and other promotional incentives.

Evaluate products based on customer demand, reviews, pricing, commission potential, competition, content opportunities, and overall brand quality.

Monitor TikTok trends, viral products, seasonal opportunities, creator campaigns, and emerging categories.

Maintain an organized pipeline of products, samples, content ideas, commission rates, and performance results.

Recommend which products should be prioritized for content production.



UGC Video Creation



Develop original video concepts designed to promote TikTok Shop products naturally and persuasively.

Script, film, edit, and publish high-quality vertical videos optimized for TikTok.

Create product demonstrations, reviews, tutorials, problem-and-solution videos, unboxings, comparisons, testimonials, lifestyle content, and trend-based videos.

Write compelling hooks, captions, on-screen text, and calls to action.

Produce multiple creative variations to test different hooks, angles, formats, and audiences.

Ensure videos feel authentic and entertaining while clearly communicating each product’s benefits.

Follow TikTok Shop policies, advertising disclosure requirements, brand guidelines, and content best practices.

Maintain a consistent publishing schedule and meet agreed content deadlines.



Performance Optimization

Identify the creative styles, products, and messaging that generate the strongest results.

Use performance data to improve future videos and scale successful concepts.

Test different opening hooks, video lengths, calls to action, posting times, and product positioning.

Provide regular updates on content performance, product opportunities, and outreach activity.



Brand Outreach and Partnerships



Research brands that are a strong fit for our content, audience, and TikTok Shop strategy.

Contact brands through
, TikTok, creator marketplaces, social media, and other appropriate channels.

Look for opportunities to convert successful affiliate content into paid collaborations or ongoing retainers.



Required Qualifications



Experience creating TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or other short-form vertical video content.

Strong understanding of TikTok trends, hooks, storytelling, audience retention, and purchasing behavior.

Ability to research products and recognize promising affiliate opportunities.

Strong on-camera communication skills and a natural, relatable presentation style.

Experience filming and editing videos using tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software.

Strong written communication and professional outreach skills.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.

Comfortable contacting brands, following up, and discussing partnership opportunities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience securing brand deals or managing creator partnerships.

Understanding of content analytics, conversion tracking, and creative testing.

Familiarity with TikTok Shop’s affiliate tools, creator campaigns, product samples, and commission structures.

Experience writing scripts, developing creative briefs, and negotiating content usage rights.

What Success Looks Like



Success in this position will be measured by:



Consistent production of high-quality TikTok Shop videos.

Growth in product clicks, conversions, sales, and affiliate revenue.

Strong video engagement and audience retention.

Number and quality of new brand relationships established.

To Apply

title: Etsy Digital Product Designer & Shop Builder – Small Business Forms & Template Bundles
description:
I am building a new Etsy shop focused on digital products that help small service-based businesses run more professionally and efficiently.



I am looking for a creative, organized, and experienced person who can help me build the shop from the ground up, including product research, template creation, branding, mockups, Etsy listings, and SEO.



The shop will offer both individual business forms/templates and larger coordinated bundles or complete operational systems. Customers may be able to purchase one specific document they need or save by purchasing a larger package containing multiple related forms.



The initial business niches will include:



Professional Organizing

Residential Cleaning

Pet Sitting / Dog Walking

Mobile Auto Detailing

Photography

Home Staging

Event Planning



Additional small-business niches will be added over time.



Types of Products We Will Create



Products may be sold individually, as smaller themed bundles, or as complete business systems.



Examples include:



Client intake forms

Lead inquiry forms

Consultation questionnaires

Client assessments

Service agreements

Contract templates

Proposal templates

Estimate and quote templates

Pricing guides

Service menus

Welcome packets

Client onboarding forms

Client preparation guides

Policies and procedures

Scheduling forms

Service checklists

Project checklists

Client communication templates

 templates

Follow-up forms

Cancellation and rescheduling policies

Payment policy forms

Client feedback forms

Review request templates

Referral forms

Offboarding documents

Internal workflow templates

Business trackers

Client management forms

Business organization templates



For example, a professional organizer may be able to purchase a Client Intake Form individually, a Client Onboarding Bundle containing several related documents, or a much larger Professional Organizer Business Forms Bundle containing most of the documents needed to manage clients from inquiry through project completion.



The goal is to give customers options at different price points while also creating larger, higher-value bundles.



Your Responsibilities



You will help:



Research each business niche and determine which forms and templates business owners are actively looking for

Identify opportunities for both individual products and bundles

Create professional editable templates, primarily in Canva

Develop coordinated collections so individual products can later be combined into bundles

Create clean, attractive, easy-to-use business documents

Maintain consistent branding and formatting across product collections

Create Etsy listing images and professional mockups

Prepare customer instruction PDFs and Canva template links

Create Etsy SEO titles, descriptions, and 13 tags

Research competitors and Etsy search opportunities

Recommend new products based on demand and gaps in the market

Help organize the Etsy shop into logical sections and product categories

Help develop larger premium bundles from individual products



I want the product catalog built strategically so that one form can become several selling opportunities.



For example:



Client Intake Form ? Client Onboarding Bundle ? Complete Business Forms Bundle



This will allow us to create a large Etsy catalog while also offering customers multiple purchasing options.



The Person I Am Looking For



You should be very comfortable using Canva and have a strong eye for professional, attractive business-document design.



Etsy experience is strongly preferred, especially experience with:



Digital products

Etsy SEO

Etsy keyword research

Canva templates

Small-business documents

Printable forms

Business systems

Client onboarding materials



Strong written English is important because many of these products will contain customer-facing business language.



You should also be extremely organized. We will be creating many related products, and documents need to be designed so they can work both individually and as part of larger coordinated bundles.



I am especially interested in someone who can research, think strategically, and suggest products, rather than waiting for me to provide every idea.



Product Research Is Important



I do not want someone who only knows how to make attractive Canva templates.



I want someone who can help answer questions such as:



What forms does a residential cleaning business actually need?

What documents are photographers searching for?

What forms are selling individually on Etsy?

Which products should be combined into bundles?

Which business niches have good demand but less competition?

What important forms are competitors leaving out?

How can we create a better or more complete product?



The goal is to create products that solve real operational problems for small-business owners.



Original Work Only



All work must be original and created specifically for this shop.



I do not want:



Copied Etsy listings

Copied competitor templates

Resold PLR products

Copyrighted designs

Templates purchased elsewhere and slightly modified



Any fonts, graphics, photos, icons, or design assets used must be appropriate for commercial use.



For contracts, legal forms, waivers, or other documents that could create legal obligations, templates should be clearly presented as customizable business templates and not represented as attorney-prepared legal advice unless they have actually been reviewed by a qualified attorney.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is not intended to be a one-time project.



My goal is to build a large Etsy digital-product shop containing potentially hundreds of listings across multiple small-business niches.



The shop will include:



Individual Forms ? Small Bundles ? Client Systems ? Complete Business Bundles



If we work well together, there will be ongoing work creating additional products, adding new industries, improving listings, creating bundles, researching keywords, and expanding the shop.



I am looking for someone who is interested in helping me build and grow the business long term.



To Apply



Please include the following:



A short introduction about your experience.

Examples of Canva templates, business documents, Etsy digital products, or forms you have created.

Details about any Etsy shops you have helped create or manage.

Your experience with Etsy SEO and keyword/product research.

Your experience creating digital products.

Your hourly rate and/or project rate.

How many hours per week you are available.

Which niche you would recommend we launch first: professional organizing, residential cleaning, pet sitting, mobile detailing, photography, home staging, or event planning.

Give me 5 individual digital products you would create first for that niche.

At the very top of your application, write “DIGITAL FORMS” so I know you read the entire posting.



Please do not send a generic application.



I am looking for someone who understands how to build a digital-product catalog strategically, where products can be sold individually and then combined into increasingly valuable bundles and complete business systems.

title: Executive Recruiter
description:
Executive Recruiter / HR Specialist | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



You're not just filling seats. You're protecting the standard every hire either raises or lowers.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



This is not a transactional recruiting role.



We're looking for an Executive Recruiter who operates as both a strategic hiring partner and trusted advisor — to clients, to leadership, and to the candidates moving through the process. You'll manage full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles while supporting the HR operations that keep the internal team running well.



You'll work directly with clients to understand their business and what a great hire looks like — then go build it. The judgment calls you make directly shape the teams clients trust us to build. We need someone who takes that seriously.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best recruiters we've worked with share a few traits:



They protect the bar. When a candidate is almost right, they don't talk themselves into a yes — they know a weak hire is never the safe option, just a delayed and more expensive problem.



They're honest even when it costs them. If a role brief is unclear, they push back. If a candidate isn't the right fit, they say so — directly, kindly, and early.



They're genuinely curious. They don't run the same interviewscript for every role — they study the business, ask questions other recruiters miss, and keep getting sharper at reading people over time.



They build systems, not just pipelines. Every hiring cycle produces something better than the last — tighter screening, cleaner processes, sharper evaluation criteria.



Who Thrives Here



People who care deeply about quality — in who they hire, in how they advise clients, and in how they work. You find satisfaction in identifying the right person. You take it personally when a weak candidate slips through. You're organized, direct, and comfortable making judgment calls without needing consensus.



We're a growing MSP — not every process is built yet. For the right person, that's the opportunity to build the systems that scale with the business, not just manage what already exists.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where clients need to hire well across multiple roles, industries, and seniority levels — and where the quality of every hire reflects directly on our company.



That looks like:



Managing full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles — from intake through offer, owning every step



Leading intake calls with clients — understanding their business, pushing back when a brief isn't clear enough to hire well against, and providing strategic hiring recommendations when needed



Proactively sourcing and headhunting candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, networks, and AI-powered tools — not waiting for applications



Conducting structured interviews that assess mindset, ownership, communication, and cultural fit — not just credentials



Presenting candidates with clear, honest hiring recommendations so clients make better decisions faster



Writing and posting culture-fit job descriptions across all platforms that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones



Supporting HR operations — onboarding, contractor documentation, records management, and internal policy compliance



Tracking recruitment metrics and pipeline health — surfacing what's working and what needs to change



Building and improving recruitment SOPs, interview guides, scorecards, and onboarding checklists



Using AI tools to accelerate sourcing, screening, and communication without cutting corners on quality



What We're Looking For



Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to; clients and candidates always feel heard



Strong full-cycle recruitment experience — executive, technical, and specialized roles across multiple clients or industries



Proven client communication and stakeholder management skills — you run intake calls, push back on vague briefs, and advise with confidence



Sharp interviewing and candidate assessment ability — you probe for specifics and can tell the difference between someone who sounds good and someone who actually is



Active, confident use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, LinkedIn Recruiter, or equivalent) — daily use, not occasional



Strong proactive sourcing and headhunting skills — you build pipelines, you don't wait for them



Proficiency in ATS platforms and HR tools (Workable, ClickUp, or equivalent)



High integrity and sound judgment — honest calls, confidential information handled without exceptions



Self-directed once you understand the environment — but asks the right questions early



Nice to Have



Experience in executive search, agency recruitment, or outsourcing environments



Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand how we hire, our clients, our tools, and how the business operates. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly — and significant latitude to shape how we hire and build the team.



We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like

At three months:



You've run multiple full-cycle searches end-to-end. Your candidate assessments are sharp, honest, and already what leadership and clients rely on. You know the business well enough to push back on a vague brief.



At six months:



Hiring is faster and more consistent. JDs are stronger. Screening is tighter. Onboarding is more structured. Recruitment metrics are visible and being used to improve the process.



At twelve months:



We hire better because of the systems you built. Weak candidates don't make it through. Strong ones move quickly. Clients trust your judgment — and we're investing in your continued growth.



How We Work



You won't be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and give them the space to do it. Meaningful work means making decisions — and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn and move forward.



We're a growing MSP — not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You treat hiring as a numbers game — more applications, faster fills



You talk yourself into candidates who are almost right because the pipeline is thin



You present candidates without a clear, honest recommendation behind them



You need a fully built system handed to you



You're uncomfortable pushing back on clients or leadership when the direction isn't right



You've never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don't intend to start



There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

ntum

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
If your instinct when something breaks is to fix the pipeline before fixing the symptom — this role was built for you.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You're not here to deploy code and move on. You're here to make sure the systems that deliver that code are reliable, secure, automated, and continuously improving.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who thinks in pipelines, not tasks. You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our development and client environments running — CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, cloud platforms, monitoring, and security. When something breaks, you find the root cause. When something works, you ask how to make it more reliable, more automated, and less dependent on human intervention next time.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best DevOps engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

They treat manual processes as technical debt. If something requires a human to do it repeatedly, their instinct is to eliminate that dependency — not just document it

They take ownership. From the 
nt an infrastructure problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's resolved, documented, and hardened against happening again

They think in systems. They don't just fix what's broken — they ask what else could break, and why, and build accordingly

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and deployment risks are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. The DevOps landscape moves fast. Twelve months from now they know more than they do today — because they made sure of it



Who Thrives Here



People who are technically sharp, operationally minded, and genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that just works. You don't wait to be handed a list of things to automate — you find them. You're comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful under pressure, and you care more about system reliability than staying in a defined lane.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. For the right engineer, that's not a warning — it's the opportunity to build things the right way from the ground up.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where development pipelines, Linux infrastructure, cloud systems, and client integrations all need an engineer who can own them end-to-end. Your job isn't just to keep things running — it's to make them run better, more reliably, and with less human intervention every month.

That looks like:



Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that make deployments fast, reliable, and repeatable — so shipping code is a non-event, not a risk

Managing and administering Linux servers (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) across development and client environments — knowing these systems well enough to troubleshoot them at any layer

Administering web servers (Nginx, Apache) and databases — keeping them performant, secure, and maintainable

Implementing client-requested integrations — understanding what's being asked, translating it into a reliable technical solution, and delivering it cleanly

Conducting root cause analysis on production errors — not just fixing what's visible, but understanding what allowed it to happen and building the safeguard that prevents it

Building scripts and automation (Bash required; Python and PHP a plus) that eliminate repetitive manual work from the team's daily operations

Monitoring infrastructure, resource utilization, and security events — building alerting systems that catch problems before they become i

Designing and enforcing DevSecOps practices — making security a built-in part of the pipeline, not an afterthought

Working with cloud platforms and virtualization — managing hypervisors and cloud service providers with the confidence of someone who's done it in production



What We're Looking For



Proven experience in Linux server administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) — you know these systems well enough to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize them without a guide

Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've built and maintained real pipelines, not just used them; you know what makes a deployment safe and what makes it a liability

Strong version control administration — Git, remote repositories, branching strategies, code review workflows; you manage these with intention, not just habit

Web server administration experience — Nginx and Apache, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

Database administration experience — you can manage database servers, optimize queries, and keep data environments healthy

Bash scripting proficiency (required) — you write automation that works, that others can read, and that makes the team faster; Python and PHP experience is a plus

Solid cloud computing and virtualization experience — working with hypervisors and cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent) in real production environments

Infrastructure and event monitoring experience — you build alerting systems that surface the right information at the right time, not noise

Understanding of DevSecOps — you treat security as part of the build, not something bolted on at the end

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of a production issue, not just the fastest path to closing the ticket

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you surface risks and blockers clearly and early, even when the news isn't good

Long-term mindset — you want to build something that lasts, not move on when things get complex





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our infrastructure, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape the infrastructure, the pipelines, and how we build.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.





What Success Looks Like



At three months: You have a clear picture of the infrastructure landscape — what's healthy, what's fragile, and what needs to be rebuilt. At least one significant manual process has been automated. Your documentation is already what the team references.

At six months: Deployments are more reliable and less stressful than when you joined. Monitoring is catching problems before they become i
. The team is spending less time on reactive firefighting and more time building.

At twelve months: The infrastructure is measurably more stable, secure, and automated than before you joined. You've built systems the team depends on — and you're already identifying the next layer of improvement. The company is investing in your next step.





How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients and internal teams depend on the infrastructure you manage — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the infrastructure, automations, and systems that make us better as we grow.





This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a defined list of tasks to know what to work on

You deploy the fix without asking what caused the failure

You treat documentation and runbooks as someone else's job

You're comfortable with fragile systems as long as they're currently running

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You're looking for a low-pressure remote role with predictable, well-defined work

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.





What We Offer





Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: Purchasing Agent/Procurement Account Representative
description:
Purchasing Agent/Procurement Account Representative 

McKenzie Freight Solutions LLC

Remote | Immediate Start

About McKenzie Freight Solutions

McKenzie Freight Solutions provides procurement, logistics, and supply chain services to independently owned retailers throughout The Bahamas.

We are rapidly deploying an internal operations platform to support our procurement, pricing, warehouse, logistics, finance, and customer management workflows.

This is NOT an eCommerce website.

Our Procurement Account Representatives build customer orders over the phone by pricing the products retailers already purchase every week. The platform supports product pricing, landed costs, quotations, invoicing, supplier purchasing, warehouse coordination, logistics, customer communications, and operational reporting.

We are assembling our founding operations team and are looking for professionals who enjoy building long-term customer relationships while helping independently owned retailers reduce their procurement costs.



Compensation

Launch Sprint: $3.00 USD/hour

Ongoing Operating Rate: $4.00 USD/hour

Procurement Account Representatives who successfully complete the launch period, demonstrate excellent attendance, professionalism, communication, product knowledge, and consistently follow procedures with minimal operational errors will be eligible to transition to the ongoing operating rate following Cycle 1.

Estimated Hours

20–40+ hours during the launch sprint depending on call volume.



Immediate 48-Hour Launch Sprint

Applicants must be available to begin immediately.

We are launching a live wholesale procurement platform serving independently owned retailers throughout The Bahamas.

Training, operating procedures, call scripts, and the procurement platform will be provided before contacting customers.



About the Role

This is NOT a cold calling position.

There is no outbound cold prospecting.

Our Independent Marketing Representatives have already visited retailers in person, verified each business, and introduced McKenzie Freight Solutions.

During those visits, retailers were informed that they would be assigned a dedicated Procurement Account Representative to assist them with pricing, quotations, and their first purchase order.

You will be assigned a portfolio of retailers and will work with the same customers during recurring weekly purchasing cycles.

Your responsibility is not to pressure customers into making a purchase.

Your responsibility is to understand each customer's business, listen carefully to what they need immediately, prepare accurate product quotations, demonstrate potential savings, and build long-term procurement relationships.

You must be highly detail-oriented. Every customer conversation results in the creation of a purchase order, so accuracy in product selection, quantities, package sizes, case packs, and customer information is essential.



Customer Relationship Management

Each Procurement Account Representative will manage an assigned portfolio of retailers.

You are expected to become familiar with your customers and understand:

Their business

Their weekly purchasing patterns

Preferred brands

Value-brand alternatives

Retail package sizes

Foodservice package sizes

Typical order quantities

Frequently purchased products

New product requests

Your goal is to become your customer's trusted procurement representative throughout each weekly purchasing cycle.



Product Knowledge

Applicants should be comfortable learning and discussing products commonly purchased by Caribbean retailers, including:

Grocery

Beverages

Household products

Cleaning supplies

Paper products

Foodservice products

Applicants should understand or be willing to quickly learn:

Retail package sizes versus foodservice package sizes

Case pack configurations

Cases per pallet

Brand-name products

Comparable value-brand alternatives

Training will be provided.



Responsibilities

Contact your assigned retailers by phone and WhatsApp.

Introduce yourself as their dedicated Procurement Account Representative.

Build long-term customer relationships.

Listen carefully to the customer's immediate purchasing needs.

Price-check products the customer already purchases.

Search requested products within the procurement platform.

Compare wholesale pricing with approved suppliers, including Jetro, Costco, Sam's Club, and other available supplier pricing.

Discuss estimated landed costs and potential savings.

Recommend appropriate brand or value-brand alternatives when available.

Accurately build detailed customer purchase orders within the procurement platform.

Verify products, quantities, package sizes, and case pack configurations before issuing quotations and invoices.

Submit Source Item Requests for products not currently available in the Product Universe.

Generate a tentative, non-binding invoice for the products the customer is prepared to purchase during the current purchasing cycle.

Send invoices and secure payment links through WhatsApp.

Schedule follow-up conversations for future purchasing cycles.

Maintain accurate customer notes and purchasing history.



Required Skills

Excellent spoken English.

Professional phone etiquette.

Strong customer service skills.

Excellent communication and listening skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to accurately build customer purchase orders.

Ability to identify and compare products across multiple suppliers.

Typing accuracy.

Basic computer skills.

Reliable internet connection.

Quiet work environment.

USB headset with microphone.

Positive attitude.

Ability to learn product knowledge quickly.

Ability to follow operating procedures accurately.

Sales experience is preferred but not required.



Preferred Experience

Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:

Grocery

Wholesale

Procurement

Retail

Foodservice

Distribution

Customer Service

Call Center

Hospitality

Knowledge of grocery products, wholesale purchasing, foodservice products, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) is a significant advantage.



What We Are Looking For

Applicants must:

Enjoy helping customers solve procurement challenges.

Build long-term customer relationships.

Be dependable and punctual.

Be highly detail-oriented.

Enjoy researching products and identifying the correct items for customers.

Learn quickly.

Develop strong product knowledge.

Understand that accuracy is more important than speed.

Work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Follow procedures accurately.

Represent McKenzie Freight Solutions professionally.

Be available to begin immediately.



How to Apply

Please
 the following to:



Resume

Voice recording (if available)

Customer service or procurement experience

Grocery, wholesale, or foodservice experience (if applicable)

Earliest available start date

Internet speed

Hours available during the launch sprint

Confirmation that you can begin immediately


 Subject:

Procurement Account Representative Application – [Your Name]

Qualified applicants will be contacted for interviews immediately.

We are actively hiring and expect to make offers as soon as qualified candidates are identified.

The B2B Sales Executive is responsible for identifying potential business clients, diagnosing their digital marketing bottlenecks, and presenting tailored growth strategies. title: Direct Response Copywriter — Long-Form Meta Ads for Health/Supplement Brand ($2,000/mo)
description:
We are a $600K/month oral health supplement brand selling to women 50+ in the United States through Meta 
/Instagram) ad funnels. We are hiring a full-time Direct Response Copywriter and Creative Strategist to produce our primary ad format — what we call native ads.



WHAT A NATIVE AD IS:



A native ad is a single-image
 ad with long-form direct response copy in the primary text. The copy is typically 1,500 to 4,000 words. It reads like a real person writing a story or personal experience — not a sales pitch, not a brand ad, not a product description. The image looks organic and editorial — like content, not advertising. Think x-ray images, doctor/lab visuals, handwritten sticky notes, screenshots, or low-fi photos. The ad clicks through to a long-form advertorial landing page.



If you have never written a
 ad longer than 
 words, this role is not for you.

If you do not know what an advertorial funnel is, this role is not for you.

If you think "native ad" means a short caption with a pretty product photo, this role is not for you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY:



Scan Meta Ad Library, GetHooked, BrandSearch, and other spy tools across health and supplement niches — not just oral health. You will study what is spending money in vision, joint pain, tinnitus, hair loss, weight loss, skincare, gut health, and any other health vertical where long-form native ads are running.

Identify winning native ads and understand WHY they work — the story structure, the hook, the mechanism, how the product is introduced, the emotional arc, the proof elements.

Rebuild those winning structures for our brand, our product, our mechanism, and our audience. Same story skeleton. Different angle, different product, different landing page.

Produce the full ad — both the long-form copy AND the image. You will use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to assist with copy production and Canva, Higgsfield, or similar tools for image creation.

Ship 4 to 6 unique ad concepts per day once you are fully ramped (after your first 1-2 weeks of onboarding and training).

Come up with new angles and concepts on your own — from customer reviews, Reddit threads, competitor research, and our internal research documents. You are not just cloning. You are also generating original concepts.

Identify what is working from our existing ads and iterate on it — new hooks, new story frames, new angles on the same mechanisms.



WHAT YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE:



Direct response copywriting experience. You understand hooks, mechanisms, belief installation, objection handling, proof stacking, and emotional arcs. You have written long-form copy that was used in paid advertising — not blog posts, not SEO articles, not social media captions.

Experience in the health, supplement, or wellness niche specifically. You have written ads or copy for products sold to people dealing with real health concerns — pain, aging, weight, skin, teeth, vision, hearing, joints, gut, hair, or similar. You understand how this buyer thinks, what she is afraid of, what she has already tried, and why she is skeptical.

Fluent, perfect English. Non-negotiable. Your copy must read as if it was written by or for an American woman between 50 and 75 years old. Not polished corporate English. Natural, conversational, emotional American English. If your writing sounds like a textbook or a press release, you will not pass the screening.

Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of your production workflow. You use AI to move faster — not to think for you. You can read AI output and immediately identify when the hook is weak, the voice is off, the mechanism is unclear, or the story lost the reader. You edit and improve AI output with your own judgment. You do not copy-paste blindly.

Experience using ad spy tools. You already spend time in Meta Ad Library, GetHooked, BrandSearch, AdSpy, or similar platforms studying what is running in health markets. This is something you already do — not something you are willing to learn.

Ability to create ad images. You can use Canva, Higgsfield, or similar tools to produce the single image that accompanies the ad copy. The image must look organic and editorial — not like a branded product ad.



STRONG PREFERENCES (not required but will put you ahead):



You can name 3 to 5 health or supplement brands running long-form native ads on
 right now and explain specifically what they are doing well.

You have worked with a DTC (direct-to-consumer) brand or performance marketing agency, not just freelance gig platforms.

You understand advertorial funnels — you know the difference between an ad that sends traffic to a product page versus an ad that sends traffic to an editorial-style landing page, and you know why the second one converts better on cold traffic.

You have produced native ads yourself — not just written copy, but chosen the image, matched the copy to the image, and shipped the complete ad.



THIS ROLE IS NOT:



Social media management

Brand advertising or brand awareness campaigns

Graphic design

Short-form copywriting (under 500 words)

Blog writing or SEO content

 marketing

Video editing or video ad production

A junior or entry-level position where you will learn on the job



If your portfolio is short captions, product descriptions, social posts, or brand ads, please do not apply.



TOOLS WE USE:



Claude and/or ChatGPT for AI-assisted copy production

Higgsfield for AI image and video generation

Canva for image creation and editing

Meta Ad Library for competitor research

GetHooked and BrandSearch for ad spy and research

Google Docs for production organization



You do not need to know all of these before starting. But you must already be using AI tools and ad spy tools in your current workflow.



COMPENSATION AND DETAILS:



$2,000 USD per month

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Fully remote — work from anywhere

Flexible schedule — we do not require specific hours, but we do require daily output and a daily end-of-day check-in via WhatsApp and a short Loom video recap of what you produced

2-week paid trial period — Week 1 is onboarding and training with the founder. Week 2 is independent production. If the quality and volume meet our standard, the role becomes permanent.

Do NOT apply through OnlineJobs.ph.



Apply ONLY through this Google Form:
